## Relief from Suffering Quickly and Easily

A picture is worth a thousand words. Before beginning PTL PRO sessions, this young boy faced an
ongoing variety of allergy-related challenges that affected his daily life. Today, his story serves
as a powerful reminder of what can happen when the body is supported with innovative frequency-based
laser technology.

The PTL PRO combines advanced low-level laser technology with an extensive frequency library in a
lightweight, portable system designed for today’s practitioner. Easy to learn and simple to
implement, PTL PRO helps practitioners provide personalized wellness support while integrating
seamlessly into their existing practice.

Call today for a free 30-minute consultation: 1-877-229-3000

This season has been absolutely the worst of fall allergies for one of my clients, also a health
care practitioner. Usually, she might have symptoms for a few days that resolve immediately with a
homeopathic remedy for allergies. Not this year. She pulled out everything in her natural pharmacy;
many different homeopathic combinations for hay fever, allium cepa, botanicals, nutritionals to no
avail. She was miserable and was considering canceling appointments.

I had her come in for a laser treatment. Since we didn’t have too much time I used only the seasonal
settings in the Sensitivity protocol in one visit. **She had immediate relief!** Also, she started
using BioLight’s AllerFree Seasonal, and it works amazing!

She’s happy and I’m thrilled with the results I’ve been getting with the PTL Laser.

Linda Howes CN, HHP

We had a young 19-year-old girl come to our office for help with symptoms with Lyme’s. She had been
in a wheelchair for 1.5 years. Her mother stated she was steadily going downhill, and they had gone
everywhere with no improvement and no hope.

We started her on therapy sessions with the PTL Laser. After her 7th visit, she ran into our office
into my arms thanking me. She was out of the wheelchair and was improving daily and could see her
health returning. Her mother cried the entire visit thanking us for giving her daughter’s life back.

I am so thankful for this amazing PTL Laser.

Dr. Justin Philips

The “Just Stop!” protocol is amazing! We have seen eight patients and are very pleased to report
that 7 of the 8 are smoke free. Six of the 7 have been smoke free for over 45 days.

The therapy blows you away because it’s so fast and easy, the patients simply report the cravings
are gone, little or no withdrawal symptoms, heightened sense of smell and taste and no desire to
smoke.

This may be the easiest, most effective and most profitable modality we’ve ever added to our
practice!

Dr. Hall, D.C.

At BioLight Technologies, we believe in helping as many people as possible experience dramatically

### Red Light Therapy Helping US Military Veterans

Dr. Slack’s current practice, InnovationMD, utilizes light therapy products, Aspen Laser and
TheraLight 360, to treat a wide range of conditions.

[TheraLight Video 4][TheraLight Video 4]

### TheraLight on the Today Show (USA)

Watch as the TheraLight 360 is featured on the Today Show as the latest cutting-edge technology that
helps athletes, especially the UFC, recovery faster and perform better.

[Red Light Therapy Bed][Red Light Therapy Bed]

## The Science Behind Red Light Therapy Beds

Red light therapy, also known as [photobiomodulation (PBMT)][30], works by delivering specific
wavelengths of light that stimulate your body’s natural healing processes at the cellular level.
When absorbed by the mitochondria, this light helps produce more ATP (your body’s energy source),
triggering a chain reaction that reduces inflammation, improves circulation, and accelerates repair.
This isn’t just light, it’s scientifically backed wellness technology designed to help you feel and
function better, faster.

> occurs quickly.

> I have had bad anxiety as I get older and this has helped me to cut down those bad depression
> days. I feel as though this helps me sharpen my mind and body and allows me to have more control
> over my emotions.
> 
> Seth S., 25

> Although my energy has been high before, it was even higher using the TL360. My sleep was also
> better. Overall, I found the TL360 to be slightly better and more effective than the old red light
> bed here before. As far as design and convenience, it was far superior. It was more comfortable
> and was much longer, which is needed for a tall guy like me. It was cool too and not hot; and less
> time in the bed.
> 
> JT M., 47

> Previously I felt as if I needed to nap all the time. I would feel like I needed a nap even
> driving to work.
> 
> Energy levels have improved a lot since then. Less panic attacks.
> 
> Brenna Y., 37

[Red Light Therapy Bed][Red Light Therapy Bed]

## Real Results With TheraLight Beds

[TheraLight Video 1][TheraLight Video 1]

### Former Police Officer Healing Journey with TheraLight 360

How one former police officer faced significant pain and used TheraLight red light therapy bed to
find more mobility in her neck.

[TheraLight Video 2][TheraLight Video 2]

### Red Light Therapy Helping US Military Veterans

Hundreds of US Military Veterans are helped every day using a combination of light therapy
modalities to treat pain and cognitive diseases related to military service.

[TheraLight Video 3][TheraLight Video 3]

### Dr Tennant Slack Talks about Photobiomodulation

Dr. Slack’s current practice, InnovationMD, utilizes light therapy products, Aspen Laser and
TheraLight 360, to treat a wide range of conditions.

[TheraLight Video 4][TheraLight Video 4]

### TheraLight on the Today Show (USA)

Watch as the TheraLight 360 is featured on the Today Show as the latest cutting-edge technology that
helps athletes, especially the UFC, recovery faster and perform better.

[Red Light Therapy Bed][Red Light Therapy Bed]

## The Science Behind Red Light Therapy Beds

Red light therapy, also known as [photobiomodulation (PBMT)][30], works by delivering specific
wavelengths of light that stimulate your body’s natural healing processes at the cellular level.
When absorbed by the mitochondria, this light helps produce more ATP (your body’s energy source),
triggering a chain reaction that reduces inflammation, improves circulation, and accelerates repair.
This isn’t just light, it’s scientifically backed wellness technology designed to help you feel and
function better, faster.

1.0 million people were discharged form hospitals with stroke as a primary diagnosis in 2010.

###### Traumatic Brain Injury][63]

An Estimated 1.7 million traumatic brain injuries (TBI) occur each year with over 275,000
hospitalizations.  An estimated 3.2 million Americans are estimated to 

be living with disability related to TBI. Statistics are rising and this condition is getting more
attention on account of 

an increase in blast concussions within the military and chronic traumatic encephalopathy as a
result of repeated 

head injuries in high impact sports.

[Read more >>][64]

###### [Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder][65]

Not all injuries can be seen. Traumatic life events impact people of all ages and can change their
lives forever. An estimated 24.4 million Americans have PTSD at any given time. 
Whether this is a result of a direct physical injury or an emotionally traumatic event, both can
impact one's ability to live life to the fullest.

## Integrative Neurorehabilitation

[image.png]

## [Dr. Douglas S. Wingate][45]

[Schedule A Consult ][46]

[Non-Invasive Brain Stimulation][47]
[Neurofeedback - Neurogen Brain Balancing][48]

[Photobiomodulation][50]

[Neuromuscular Re-education][52]
[Neuromycology][53]
[Psychedelic Assisted Neurorehabilitation][54]

[[now available_edited.jpg]][55]

### Books By Dr. Wingate

##### A Leader in non-invasive brain stimulation, neuromycology, and psychedelic-assisted
##### neurorehabilitation

[See All Books >][56]

[[front cover.jpg]][57]
[[healing final cover.jpg]][58]
[][59]
[[Neuromycology cover.jpeg]][60]

###### [Post-Stroke Recovery][61]

6.4 million Americans are estimated to have had cerebrovascular accident, more commonly called a
stroke.

1.0 million people were discharged form hospitals with stroke as a primary diagnosis in 2010.
After discharge there can still be significant healthcare needs for the 

individual, sometimes requiring months to years of onoing care. 

[Read more >>][62]

###### [Concussion &
###### Traumatic Brain Injury][63]

An Estimated 1.7 million traumatic brain injuries (TBI) occur each year with over 275,000
hospitalizations.  An estimated 3.2 million Americans are estimated to 

be living with disability related to TBI. Statistics are rising and this condition is getting more
attention on account of 

an increase in blast concussions within the military and chronic traumatic encephalopathy as a
result of repeated 

head injuries in high impact sports.

[Read more >>][64]

###### [Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder][65]

Not all injuries can be seen. Traumatic life events impact people of all ages and can change their
lives forever. An estimated 24.4 million Americans have PTSD at any given time. 
Whether this is a result of a direct physical injury or an emotionally traumatic event, both can
impact one's ability to live life to the fullest. 
 

[Read more >>][66]

## What is Photobiomodulation and how it works

Photobiomodulation (PBM)—often referred to as red light therapy—uses specific red and near-infrared
wavelengths (typically 633–1074nm) to support cellular performance and recovery mechanisms, without
heat, pain, or downtime.

Cellular energy (ATP)

Light energy is absorbed by cellular chromophores—primarily within mitochondria—supporting efficient
ATP production, signaling, and performance pathways.

Non-thermal, repeatable protocols

PBM is non-invasive and non-thermal. Outcomes depend on wavelength, irradiance, and exposure time—so
systems must deliver controlled, uniform full-body distribution.

How it works: a 4-layer biological cascade

This is a simplified educational model of how red light therapy (PBM) can translate photons into
cellular and systemic responses.

Therapeutic wavelength range
660nm
810nm
830nm
860nm
940nm
1074nm
Layer 1 — Light entry & optical interaction
* • Selective penetration through epidermis, dermis, and deeper tissues (wavelength dependent).
* • Chromophore absorption: cytochrome c oxidase, porphyrins, water clusters, opsins.
Layer 2 — Bioenergetic conversion (mitochondrial shift)
* • Near-infrared light may release nitric oxide (NO) blockade in respiration.
* • Electron flow and oxygen efficiency improve → ATP output rises.
* • NO supports microvascular flow via vasodilation.
Layer 3 — Cellular remodeling & biological response
* • Structural repair signaling (collagen, elastin, fibroblast activity).
* • Inflammatory modulation and oxidative stress balance.
* • Neurological support and synaptic efficiency.
Layer 4 — System integration & balance
* • Circadian and biological rhythm support.
* • Enhanced mind-body performance and recovery.
* • Improved cellular communication and coherence.

Effects vary by protocol, wavelength selection, and individual factors.

formation spécialisée auprès du Dr Dale Bredesen à Los Angeles, pionnier mondial de la recherche, il
maîtrise le protocole ReCODE — une approche innovante visant à prévenir, ralentir et inverser les

PROTOCOLE RECODE

# La fin d'Alzheimer

Développé par le Dr Dale Bredesen, ReCODE est une approche novatrice qui repose sur une analyse
approfondie des facteurs biologiques, génétiques et environnementaux du déclin cognitif. Il corrige
les déséquilibres sous-jacents par des stratégies personnalisées : nutrition, suppléments, sommeil,
gestion du stress et activité physique adaptée.
 

Aux stades précoces de la maladie d'Alzheimer, certains patients ont pu inverser leurs symptômes et
retrouver une meilleure qualité de vie.

LA PHOTOBIOMODULATION

# La lumière au service du cerveau

La photobiomodulation transcrânienne délivre une lumière rouge et proche infrarouge (810–1064 nm) à
travers le crâne pour stimuler les mitochondries neuronales — augmentant l'ATP, réduisant le stress
oxydatif et la neuroinflammation.
 

Une étude sur la déficience cognitive légère, menée avec l'Université de Toronto et l'hôpital St.
Michael's, a montré après 6 semaines des améliorations des performances cognitives, de la
connectivité cérébrale et de la fonction mitochondriale.

### Qu'est-ce qu'une section FAQ?

Une section FAQ peut être utilisée pour répondre rapidement aux questions fréquemment posées sur

### Pourquoi les FAQ sont-elles importantes?

Les FAQ sont un excellent moyen d'aider les visiteurs à trouver rapidement des réponses aux
questions courantes sur votre entreprise et de créer une meilleure expérience de navigation sur
votre site.

### Où puis-je ajouter mes FAQ?

Les FAQ peuvent être ajoutées à n'importe quelle page de votre site ou sur votre appli mobile Wix.

### Comment puis-je ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse?

Pour ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse, suivez ces étapes:

1. Depuis le tableau de bord ou l'Éditeur, cliquez sur le bouton «Gérer la FAQ».

2. Cliquez sur «Ajouter», puis sélectionnez «Question/Réponse».

3. Choisissez une catégorie pour votre question/réponse.

4. Enregistrez et publiez.


Vous pouvez modifier votre FAQ à tout moment.

### Puis-je ajouter une image, une vidéo ou un GIF à ma FAQ?

Oui. Pour ajouter un média, suivez ces étapes:

1. Depuis le tableau de bord ou l'Éditeur, cliquez sur le bouton «Gérer la FAQ».

2. Créez une nouvelle question/réponse ou modifiez-en une existante.

3. Dans la zone de texte de la réponse, cliquez sur l'icône Vidéo, Image ou GIF.

4. Ajoutez le média depuis votre bibliothèque puis enregistrez.

### Comment puis-je modifier ou retirer le titre «Questions fréquemment posées»?

Depuis l'Éditeur, rendez-vous dans l'onglet «Paramètres» de la FAQ.

Depuis l'appli Wix Owner, rendez-vous dans l'onglet Site et appli.

Les FAQ sont un excellent moyen d'aider les visiteurs à trouver rapidement des réponses aux
questions courantes sur votre entreprise et de créer une meilleure expérience de navigation sur
votre site.

### Où puis-je ajouter mes FAQ?

Les FAQ peuvent être ajoutées à n'importe quelle page de votre site ou sur votre appli mobile Wix.

### Comment puis-je ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse?

Pour ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse, suivez ces étapes:

1. Depuis le tableau de bord ou l'Éditeur, cliquez sur le bouton «Gérer la FAQ».

2. Cliquez sur «Ajouter», puis sélectionnez «Question/Réponse».

3. Choisissez une catégorie pour votre question/réponse.

4. Enregistrez et publiez.


Vous pouvez modifier votre FAQ à tout moment.

### Puis-je ajouter une image, une vidéo ou un GIF à ma FAQ?

Oui. Pour ajouter un média, suivez ces étapes:

1. Depuis le tableau de bord ou l'Éditeur, cliquez sur le bouton «Gérer la FAQ».

2. Créez une nouvelle question/réponse ou modifiez-en une existante.

3. Dans la zone de texte de la réponse, cliquez sur l'icône Vidéo, Image ou GIF.

4. Ajoutez le média depuis votre bibliothèque puis enregistrez.

### Comment puis-je modifier ou retirer le titre «Questions fréquemment posées»?

Depuis l'Éditeur, rendez-vous dans l'onglet «Paramètres» de la FAQ.

Depuis l'appli Wix Owner, rendez-vous dans l'onglet Site et appli.

You are welcome here! You are invited to begin a journey of healing and self-discovery where you can

## Reiki Certification Classes in Nashville, TN

[Reiki Certification Classes in Nashville, TN]

Reiki offers you a simple, powerful way to restore balance and support healing. As you learn to work
with universal life force energy, you begin to release tension, deepen awareness, and create harmony
within yourself and those around you.

If you feel called to Reiki, you are ready for something new. You can begin where you are and grow
at your own pace. Each class supports you in building confidence, expanding awareness, and
discovering how to work with energy in a natural and powerful way. Choose the path that feels right
for you below.

You are supported every step of the way. With clear, compassionate guidance, you can easily connect
with Reiki, trust your abilities, and grow in confidence. As you continue, you begin to realize just
how powerful your energy truly is.
* [Reiki 1 Classes][23]

## Private Training, Sessions & Consultations

Your path can expand beyond Reiki. You have access to private sessions, classes, and coaching in
natural medicine designed to support your mind, body, and spirit. These offerings help you restore
balance, deepen awareness, and create lasting, meaningful change.
* [Animal Reiki][28]
* [Chakra Balancing][29]
* Essential Oils
* Herbal Consultations
* [Hypnosis][30]
* [Past Life Regression][31]
* [Reiki][32]

## Transparency in Care

About BIO

The Biotechnology Innovation Organization (BIO) is the premier biotechnology advocacy organization
representing biotech companies, industry leaders, and state biotech associations in the United
States and more than 35 countries around the globe. BIO members range from biotech start-ups to some
of the world’s largest biopharmaceutical companies – all united by the same goal: to develop medical
and scientific breakthroughs that prevent and fight disease, restore health, and improve patients’
lives. BIO also organizes the BIO International Convention and a series of annual conferences that
drive partnerships, investment, and progress within the sector.

representing biotech companies, industry leaders, and state biotech associations in the United
States and more than 35 countries around the globe. BIO members range from biotech start-ups to some
of the world’s largest biopharmaceutical companies – all united by the same goal: to develop medical
and scientific breakthroughs that prevent and fight disease, restore health, and improve patients’
lives. BIO also organizes the BIO International Convention and a series of annual conferences that
drive partnerships, investment, and progress within the sector.

## About Us

At our Naples, FL-based Brain Rejuvenation Clinic, we specialize in cutting-edge, science-backed
therapies designed to restore and optimize brain health. We incorporate the WAVi Scan System which
allows clinicians to identify early signs of cognitive impairment and tailor treatment protocols to
optimize patient outcomes. Utilizing BAHI Therapy, Hydrogen Inhalation, Photo Biomodulation, and
Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, we activate the body's natural healing processes to enhance cognitive
function and neurological recovery. Our expert team is dedicated to providing personalized,
non-invasive testing and treatments that support brain restoration, mental clarity, and overall
well-being. Experience the future of brain health with innovative therapies that rejuvenate your
mind from the inside out.

# Dalton Brothers

##### O.D. Doctor of Optometry

Brothers Vision Consulting delivers exceptional consultation services backed by a board-certified
optometrist. Our clinician-led sessions are designed to enhance your skills and expertise when
integrating emerging technology into your clinics. Together, we will explore the research that paved
the way for these novel therapies and help improve the communications that leads to better patient
outcomes.

## Areas of Expertise

##### Ocular Aesthetics, Advanced Dry Eye, Regenerative Medicine & Vision Industry Consultation.

[IMG_8555.JPG]

Welcome to Brothers Vision Consulting, where exceptional eye care meets innovative solutions. Led by
Dalton Brothers, O.D., a proud third-generation optometrist, our consultancy is dedicated to
advancing the field of eye care. Dalton graduated from the University of Missouri Saint Louis
College of Optometry in 2019 and has since joined his family's esteemed practice in Joplin,
Missouri. He specializes in ocular aesthetics and dry eye, providing cutting-edge therapies such as
Plate Rich Plasma, Intense Pulsed Light, and Photobiomodulation.

 

In 2021, Dalton expanded his passion for eye care by offering consulting services to fellow
optometrists and ophthalmologists, helping them integrate these advanced therapies into their own
clinics. Our mission is to empower eye care professionals with knowledge and innovative techniques
aimed at enhancing patient outcomes.


Outside of the clinic, Dalton cherishes time spent with his wife and three daughters, bringing a
family-oriented approach to his practice. At Brothers Vision Consulting, we strive to provide the
highest level of care and expertise in every interaction.

Areas of Expertise

## Consultation Services

1

### Advanced InfinityPro LLLT Applications

During these sessions, we will focus on how to implement low level light therapy (LLLT) technology
into your clinic, how to communicate this therapy with staff and patients, and establish a line of
communication for ongoing clinical support for 12 months. Anything I've designed to make my life
easier in clinic will be made available to you as well, including patient handouts, log sheets,
consent forms and much more! 

[More Info ][6]

2

### Advanced Dry Eye Therapies: (IPL + LLLT)

During this training session, we aim to empower providers to confidently implement Intense Pulsed
Light (IPL) and Low Level Light Therapy (LLLT) to enhance both their dry eye and aesthetic outcomes
within their clinics. Our comprehensive training covers crucial aspects, including patient
selection, treatment vs. maintenance care, and effective communication strategies. Additionally, 6
months of ongoing clinical support is also included with this purchase. 

[More Info ][7]

3

### Industry Partner Consultation

Brothers Vision Consulting offers assistance in the publishing of  independent clinical findings,
including research study assessments and protocol design. We offer sponsorships through public
health webinars and podcasts involving, dry eye, aesthetics, and various other applications
regarding the use of diagnostic and therapeutic devices. Through these partnerships, we offer
ongoing strategic guidance for companies within the vision industry.  

[More Info ][8]

follicles. 780nm reaches the blood vessels that feed them — a layer no previous Capillus device has
accessed. 808nm penetrates deeper, targeting the inflammation that drives advanced hair loss. Same
six-minute daily session. A fundamentally different level of treatment.

[**Professional Scope of Practice ***][55]

The information herein on "***Home***" is not intended to replace a one-on-one relationship with a
qualified health care professional or licensed physician and is not medical advice. We encourage you
to make healthcare decisions based on your research and partnership with a qualified healthcare
professional.

[Blog Information & Scope Discussions][56]

Welcome to El Paso's Premier Wellness and Injury Care Clinic & Wellness Blog, where Dr. Alex
Jimenez, DC, FNP-C, a Multi-State board-certified **Family Practice Nurse Practitioner (FNP-BC) and
Chiropractor (DC)**, presents insights on how our multidisciplinary team is dedicated to holistic
healing and personalized care. Our practice aligns with evidence-based treatment protocols inspired
by integrative medicine principles, similar to those on this site and on our family practice-based
[chiromed.com][57] site, focusing on naturally restoring health for patients of all ages.

**Our areas of multidisciplinary practice include ** [Wellness & Nutrition][58], Chronic Pain,
[Personal Injury][59], [Auto Accident Care, Work Injuries][60], Back Injury, Low [Back Pain][61],
Neck Pain, Migraine Headaches, Sports Injuries, [Severe Sciatica][62], Scoliosis, Complex Herniated
Discs, [Fibromyalgia][63], Chronic Pain, Complex Injuries, [Stress Management, Functional Medicine
Treatments][64], and in-scope care protocols.

[Our information scope][65] is multidisciplinary, focusing on musculoskeletal and physical medicine;
wellness, contributing etiological [viscerosomatic disturbances][66] within clinical presentations,
associated somato-visceral reflex clinical dynamics; subluxation complexes, sensitive health issues,
and functional medicine articles, topics, and discussions.

We provide and facilitate [clinical collaboration][67] with specialists across disciplines. Each
specialist is governed by their professional scope of practice and licensure jurisdiction. We use
functional health & wellness protocols to treat and support care for musculoskeletal injuries or
disorders.

Our videos, posts, topics, and insights address clinical matters and issues that directly or
indirectly relate to our clinical scope of practice.

Our office has made a reasonable effort to provide supportive citations and has identified relevant
research studies that support our posts. We provide copies of supporting research studies upon
request to regulatory boards and the public.

We understand that we cover matters that require an additional explanation of how they may assist in
a particular care plan or treatment protocol; therefore, to discuss the subject matter above
further, please feel free to ask [Dr. Alex Jimenez, DC, APRN, FNP-BC][68], or contact us at
[915-850-0900][69].

We are here to help you and your family.

facility that brings together a diverse range of medical disciplines under one roof. Our mission is
to provide holistic, patient-centered care that addresses the root causes of health issues rather
than just treating symptoms.

At ChiroMed, we offer a comprehensive suite of services, including Chiropractic care, Nurse
Practitioner services, Naturopathy, Rehabilitation, Nutrition counseling, and Acupuncture. Each
service is designed to work in harmony, providing our patients with a well-rounded approach to
health and wellness.

Our team of highly skilled professionals is dedicated to helping you achieve optimal health through
personalized treatment plans that combine the best of conventional and alternative medicine. Whether
you’re recovering from an injury, managing chronic pain, or simply looking to improve your overall
well-being, ChiroMed – Integrated Medicine is here to support you every step of the way.

Experience the difference of *integrated care at ChiroMed*, where your health and well-being are our
top priorities.

[Blog Information & Scope Discussions][56]

Welcome to El Paso's Premier Wellness and Injury Care Clinic & Wellness Blog, where Dr. Alex
Jimenez, DC, FNP-C, a Multi-State board-certified **Family Practice Nurse Practitioner (FNP-BC) and
Chiropractor (DC)**, presents insights on how our multidisciplinary team is dedicated to holistic
healing and personalized care. Our practice aligns with evidence-based treatment protocols inspired
by integrative medicine principles, similar to those on this site and on our family practice-based
[chiromed.com][57] site, focusing on naturally restoring health for patients of all ages.

**Our areas of multidisciplinary practice include ** [Wellness & Nutrition][58], Chronic Pain,
[Personal Injury][59], [Auto Accident Care, Work Injuries][60], Back Injury, Low [Back Pain][61],
Neck Pain, Migraine Headaches, Sports Injuries, [Severe Sciatica][62], Scoliosis, Complex Herniated
Discs, [Fibromyalgia][63], Chronic Pain, Complex Injuries, [Stress Management, Functional Medicine
Treatments][64], and in-scope care protocols.

[Our information scope][65] is multidisciplinary, focusing on musculoskeletal and physical medicine;
wellness, contributing etiological [viscerosomatic disturbances][66] within clinical presentations,
associated somato-visceral reflex clinical dynamics; subluxation complexes, sensitive health issues,
and functional medicine articles, topics, and discussions.

We provide and facilitate [clinical collaboration][67] with specialists across disciplines. Each
specialist is governed by their professional scope of practice and licensure jurisdiction. We use
functional health & wellness protocols to treat and support care for musculoskeletal injuries or
disorders.

Our videos, posts, topics, and insights address clinical matters and issues that directly or
indirectly relate to our clinical scope of practice.

Our office has made a reasonable effort to provide supportive citations and has identified relevant
research studies that support our posts. We provide copies of supporting research studies upon
request to regulatory boards and the public.

We understand that we cover matters that require an additional explanation of how they may assist in
a particular care plan or treatment protocol; therefore, to discuss the subject matter above
further, please feel free to ask [Dr. Alex Jimenez, DC, APRN, FNP-BC][68], or contact us at
[915-850-0900][69].

We are here to help you and your family.

Wuhan Cozing Medical Devices Co., Ltd. has been dedicated to the development and manufacturing of
physical therapy laser and light-based devices for nearly a decade in China. Starting as a modest
trading company, we have grown into a leading supplier in the physiotherapy laser and therapeutic
light industry.
Today, Cozing Medical stands as a top-tier professional manufacturer specializing in physiotherapy
lasers and photodynamic therapy devices. Our diverse product portfolio includes Cold Laser Pain
Therapy Devices, Photodynamic Therapy Systems, Laser Hair Regrowth Devices, Vaginal Tightening
Lasers, Parkinson’s Treatment Helmets, and 2-in-1 Sleep Therapy Devices, among others.

physical therapy should be universal, regardless of gender, economic status, or age. That’s why we

bring better health and wellness to people worldwide.

Wuhan Cozing Medical Devices Co.,ltd

Wuhan Cozing Medical Devices Co., Ltd. has been dedicated to the development and manufacturing of
physical therapy laser and light-based devices for nearly a decade in China. Starting as a modest
trading company, we have grown into a leading supplier in the physiotherapy laser and therapeutic
light industry.
Today, Cozing Medical stands as a top-tier professional manufacturer specializing in physiotherapy
lasers and photodynamic therapy devices. Our diverse product portfolio includes Cold Laser Pain
Therapy Devices, Photodynamic Therapy Systems, Laser Hair Regrowth Devices, Vaginal Tightening
Lasers, Parkinson’s Treatment Helmets, and 2-in-1 Sleep Therapy Devices, among others.
Guided by our motto — "Everyone has the right to a healthy life" — we believe that access to quality
physical therapy should be universal, regardless of gender, economic status, or age. That’s why we
are committed to producing affordable and effective physical therapy laser devices, striving to
bring better health and wellness to people worldwide.

publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

Als überörtliche Augenarztpraxis zwischen Hamburg, Bremen und Hannover haben wir es uns zum Ziel
gesetzt, Ihnen die beste medizinische Versorgung für Ihre Augen zu bieten – Ihre Augen sind unser
Fokus. Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum der Augenheilkunde wie allgemeine Kontrollen,
erweiterte [Vorsorge][59] bis hin zur [Premium-Kataraktchirurgie][60] und Untersuchungen des [Grünen
Stars (Glaukom)][61] – gemeinsam finden wir die für Sie beste Behandlungsstruktur.

Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf eine regionale sowie persönliche Betreuung und arbeiten mit einem
professionellen Team daran, Sie zu allen Anliegen zu Ihrer Augengesundheit bestmöglich zu beraten.

In vielen medizinischen Bereichen begegnen uns immer wieder Vorsorgetermine, jedoch werden die Augen
dabei häufig außer Acht gelassen. Damit bestimmte Erkrankungen Ihres Auges bestmöglich behandelt
werden können, ist eine frühzeitige Erkennung dieser von besonderer Bedeutung. Buchen Sie daher
jetzt Ihren Vorsorgetermin.

[Warum vorsorgen?][62]

und [Katarakt][64]) bis zu Veränderungen an Ihrer [Netzhaut][65] oder anderen Leidenserscheinungen,
mit unseren Spezialisten beraten wir Sie zu unseren Behandlungsmethoden, um Ihre Sehkraft zu

# Klare Sicht, frische Augen – Trockene Augen gezielt behandeln

Trockene Augen, auch als Sicca-Syndrom bekannt, entstehen durch eine unzureichende Benetzung der
Augenoberfläche mit Tränenflüssigkeit. Ursachen können Umwelteinflüsse wie Klimaanlagen und
Bildschirmarbeit, bestimmte Medikamente oder gesundheitliche Probleme wie Diabetes sein. Symptome
umfassen Brennen, Jucken, Rötungen und ein Fremdkörpergefühl. Die Behandlung reicht von künstlichen
Tränen bis hin zu entzündungshemmenden Tropfen. Vorbeugend helfen regelmäßige Pausen bei der
Bildschirmarbeit, ausreichendes Trinken und das Vermeiden von Zugluft und Rauch.

Wenn Sie von Trockenen Augen betroffen sind, dann wenden Sie sich gern an unser [DryEye Center][83].

# Herzlich willkommen bei den Augenpartnern – Ihre Augengesundheit in guten Händen

Als überörtliche Augenarztpraxis zwischen Hamburg, Bremen und Hannover haben wir es uns zum Ziel
gesetzt, Ihnen die beste medizinische Versorgung für Ihre Augen zu bieten – Ihre Augen sind unser
Fokus. Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum der Augenheilkunde wie allgemeine Kontrollen,
erweiterte [Vorsorge][59] bis hin zur [Premium-Kataraktchirurgie][60] und Untersuchungen des [Grünen
Stars (Glaukom)][61] – gemeinsam finden wir die für Sie beste Behandlungsstruktur.

Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf eine regionale sowie persönliche Betreuung und arbeiten mit einem
professionellen Team daran, Sie zu allen Anliegen zu Ihrer Augengesundheit bestmöglich zu beraten.

[Ihre Augengesundheit in guten Händen]
[Augenuntersuchung: Vorsorge]

## Augenerkankungen gezielt erkennen und vorbeugen

In vielen medizinischen Bereichen begegnen uns immer wieder Vorsorgetermine, jedoch werden die Augen
dabei häufig außer Acht gelassen. Damit bestimmte Erkrankungen Ihres Auges bestmöglich behandelt
werden können, ist eine frühzeitige Erkennung dieser von besonderer Bedeutung. Buchen Sie daher
jetzt Ihren Vorsorgetermin.

[Warum vorsorgen?][62]

## Die passenden Behandlungen für Ihre Augengesundheit

Als qualifizierte Augenärzte in Ihrer Region stehen wir Ihnen in allen Lebenslagen zur Seite und
finden die für Sie beste Behandlung. Von Erkrankungen des Grünen oder Grauen Stars ([Glaukom][63]
und [Katarakt][64]) bis zu Veränderungen an Ihrer [Netzhaut][65] oder anderen Leidenserscheinungen,
mit unseren Spezialisten beraten wir Sie zu unseren Behandlungsmethoden, um Ihre Sehkraft zu
erhalten.

# Klare Sicht, frische Augen – Trockene Augen gezielt behandeln

Trockene Augen, auch als Sicca-Syndrom bekannt, entstehen durch eine unzureichende Benetzung der
Augenoberfläche mit Tränenflüssigkeit. Ursachen können Umwelteinflüsse wie Klimaanlagen und
Bildschirmarbeit, bestimmte Medikamente oder gesundheitliche Probleme wie Diabetes sein. Symptome
umfassen Brennen, Jucken, Rötungen und ein Fremdkörpergefühl. Die Behandlung reicht von künstlichen
Tränen bis hin zu entzündungshemmenden Tropfen. Vorbeugend helfen regelmäßige Pausen bei der
Bildschirmarbeit, ausreichendes Trinken und das Vermeiden von Zugluft und Rauch.

Wenn Sie von Trockenen Augen betroffen sind, dann wenden Sie sich gern an unser [DryEye Center][83].

Fokus. Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum der Augenheilkunde wie allgemeine Kontrollen,
erweiterte [Vorsorge][59] bis hin zur [Premium-Kataraktchirurgie][60] und Untersuchungen des [Grünen
Stars (Glaukom)][61] – gemeinsam finden wir die für Sie beste Behandlungsstruktur.

Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf eine regionale sowie persönliche Betreuung und arbeiten mit einem
professionellen Team daran, Sie zu allen Anliegen zu Ihrer Augengesundheit bestmöglich zu beraten.

[Ihre Augengesundheit in guten Händen]
[Augenuntersuchung: Vorsorge]

## Augenerkankungen gezielt erkennen und vorbeugen

In vielen medizinischen Bereichen begegnen uns immer wieder Vorsorgetermine, jedoch werden die Augen
dabei häufig außer Acht gelassen. Damit bestimmte Erkrankungen Ihres Auges bestmöglich behandelt
werden können, ist eine frühzeitige Erkennung dieser von besonderer Bedeutung. Buchen Sie daher
jetzt Ihren Vorsorgetermin.

[Warum vorsorgen?][62]

## Die passenden Behandlungen für Ihre Augengesundheit

Als qualifizierte Augenärzte in Ihrer Region stehen wir Ihnen in allen Lebenslagen zur Seite und
finden die für Sie beste Behandlung. Von Erkrankungen des Grünen oder Grauen Stars ([Glaukom][63]
und [Katarakt][64]) bis zu Veränderungen an Ihrer [Netzhaut][65] oder anderen Leidenserscheinungen,
mit unseren Spezialisten beraten wir Sie zu unseren Behandlungsmethoden, um Ihre Sehkraft zu
erhalten.

[Grauer Star][66] [Grüner Star][67] [Makula, Netzhaut & Glaskörper][68] [Hornhautverkrümmung][69]
[Lidchirurgie & ästhetische Augenheilkunde][70] [Brillenunabhängigkeit][71] [Trockene Augen][72]
[Bild zeigt Augenarzt im OP]
[Brillenfrei im Beruf]

## In allen Lebenslagen sicher unterwegs – Gutachten bei den Augenpartnern

In verschiedenen Lebenslagen sind Sie auf ein augenärztliches Gutachten angewiesen. Sei es die
Sehbescheinigung für einen [Führerschein][73], die Bestätigung Ihrer [Flugtauglichkeit][74] oder das
Bestehen einer Vorauswahl für die Arbeit bei der [Polizei][75], vereinbaren Sie gern einen
[Termin][76] bei uns.

[Führerschein][77] [Bildschirmarbeit][78] [Sportboot][79] [Flugtauglichkeit][80] [Polizei][81]
[Fahr- und Steuertätigkeit][82]

# Klare Sicht, frische Augen – Trockene Augen gezielt behandeln

Trockene Augen, auch als Sicca-Syndrom bekannt, entstehen durch eine unzureichende Benetzung der
Augenoberfläche mit Tränenflüssigkeit. Ursachen können Umwelteinflüsse wie Klimaanlagen und
Bildschirmarbeit, bestimmte Medikamente oder gesundheitliche Probleme wie Diabetes sein. Symptome
umfassen Brennen, Jucken, Rötungen und ein Fremdkörpergefühl. Die Behandlung reicht von künstlichen
Tränen bis hin zu entzündungshemmenden Tropfen. Vorbeugend helfen regelmäßige Pausen bei der
Bildschirmarbeit, ausreichendes Trinken und das Vermeiden von Zugluft und Rauch.

Wenn Sie von Trockenen Augen betroffen sind, dann wenden Sie sich gern an unser [DryEye Center][83].

## Devices We Offer

### g.tec medical engineering Systems We Offer

Entry BCI, modular EEG/BCI, research-grade amplifiers, EEG + TMS, EEG + fNIRS, multimodal
biosignals, wireless EEG, rapid clinical mapping, and BCI-based neurorehabilitation.


#### Entry BCI & Education

**Unicorn Hybrid Black**

Wearable EEG headset for fast BCI prototyping with hybrid (wet/dry) electrodes and wireless
streaming.

[See Unicorn Hybrid Black →][18]

#### Modular EEG & BCI Platform

**Unicorn BCI Core-8**

Compact 24-bit, 8-channel EEG/BCI device designed for flexible setups and institutional workflows.

[See Unicorn BCI Core-8 →][19]

#### Research-Grade EEG & Multimodal

**g.HIamp**

High-performance DC-coupled biosignal amplifier for EEG/ECoG/ECG/EMG/EOG with advanced
synchronization options.

[See g.HIamp →][20]

#### EEG + TMS Workflows

Options designed to support combined stimulation workflows, including artifact-suppression features.

[Explore Advanced TMS-EEG Integration →][21]

#### EEG + fNIRS Hybrid Neuroimaging (by NIRx)

Combine electrical activity (EEG) with hemodynamics (fNIRS) for hybrid neuroimaging pipelines.

[See g.Nautilus NIRx wearable EEG and fNIRS →][22]

#### BCI + Eye-Tracking (by Tobii)

Multimodal pipelines integrating EEG/BCI with eye-tracking and additional biosignals (GSR/EDA, HRV,
temperature).

[See EEG + Eye-Tracking →][23]

#### Wireless Wearable EEG & Biosignals

**g.Nautilus Multi-Purpose**

Wearable wireless EEG and biosignal platform supporting additional sensors and hybrid workflows.

[See g.Nautilus →][24]

#### Clinical Mapping (Rapid Cortical Mapping)

**cortiQ**

Rapid cortical mapping solution supporting fast functional mapping workflows for clinical teams.

[See cortiQ →][25]

#### Neurorehabilitation (BCI-based)

**recoveriX**

BCI-based closed-loop neurorehabilitation system designed to support motor training of upper or
lower extremities.

[See recoveriX →][26]

#### qEEG Devices

Quantitative EEG solutions for brain mapping, assessment and evidence-informed program design in
clinical and research settings.

#### Neurofeedback Systems

Clinical and research neurofeedback platforms for training, rehabilitation, and performance programs
(institutional onboarding supported).

#### Photobiomodulation (PBM)

Photobiomodulation solutions to support wellness and research programs, with guidance on device
selection and implementation planning.

#### tDCS Devices

Non-invasive stimulation systems for research and wellness programs (support for protocols,
onboarding, and institutional workflows).

#### taVNS Devices

Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation tools for autonomic regulation programs and
research applications.

## Devices We Offer

### g.tec medical engineering Systems We Offer

Entry BCI, modular EEG/BCI, research-grade amplifiers, EEG + TMS, EEG + fNIRS, multimodal
biosignals, wireless EEG, rapid clinical mapping, and BCI-based neurorehabilitation.


#### Entry BCI & Education

**Unicorn Hybrid Black**

Wearable EEG headset for fast BCI prototyping with hybrid (wet/dry) electrodes and wireless
streaming.

[See Unicorn Hybrid Black →][18]

#### Modular EEG & BCI Platform

**Unicorn BCI Core-8**

Compact 24-bit, 8-channel EEG/BCI device designed for flexible setups and institutional workflows.

[See Unicorn BCI Core-8 →][19]

#### Research-Grade EEG & Multimodal

**g.HIamp**

High-performance DC-coupled biosignal amplifier for EEG/ECoG/ECG/EMG/EOG with advanced
synchronization options.

[See g.HIamp →][20]

#### EEG + TMS Workflows

Options designed to support combined stimulation workflows, including artifact-suppression features.

[Explore Advanced TMS-EEG Integration →][21]

#### EEG + fNIRS Hybrid Neuroimaging (by NIRx)

Combine electrical activity (EEG) with hemodynamics (fNIRS) for hybrid neuroimaging pipelines.

[See g.Nautilus NIRx wearable EEG and fNIRS →][22]

#### BCI + Eye-Tracking (by Tobii)

Multimodal pipelines integrating EEG/BCI with eye-tracking and additional biosignals (GSR/EDA, HRV,
temperature).

[See EEG + Eye-Tracking →][23]

#### Wireless Wearable EEG & Biosignals

**g.Nautilus Multi-Purpose**

Wearable wireless EEG and biosignal platform supporting additional sensors and hybrid workflows.

[See g.Nautilus →][24]

#### Clinical Mapping (Rapid Cortical Mapping)

**cortiQ**

Rapid cortical mapping solution supporting fast functional mapping workflows for clinical teams.

[See cortiQ →][25]

#### Neurorehabilitation (BCI-based)

**recoveriX**

BCI-based closed-loop neurorehabilitation system designed to support motor training of upper or
lower extremities.

[See recoveriX →][26]

#### qEEG Devices

Quantitative EEG solutions for brain mapping, assessment and evidence-informed program design in
clinical and research settings.

#### Neurofeedback Systems

Clinical and research neurofeedback platforms for training, rehabilitation, and performance programs
(institutional onboarding supported).

#### Photobiomodulation (PBM)

Photobiomodulation solutions to support wellness and research programs, with guidance on device
selection and implementation planning.

#### tDCS Devices

Non-invasive stimulation systems for research and wellness programs (support for protocols,
onboarding, and institutional workflows).

#### taVNS Devices

Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation tools for autonomic regulation programs and
research applications.

All disease starts with a foundational problem. Somewhere along the line, the body lost balance,

cellular level – addressing the root cause, not just the symptoms.

The body is designed to be healthy. Unfortunately, sickness and disease have become so commonplace
in our society that it seems normal, but the reverse is actually true. Sickness, pain, and disease
are the body’s way of telling us something is wrong.  We believe that the power that made the body
can heal the body. We see our job as putting your body and nervous system in a position to function
properly. When that happens, the innate intelligence of the body takes over and gets you back to the
pain-free, optimally-functioning state you are meant to be in.

Our office also boasts the best [neuropathy treatment][73] Boise has to offer because of our large
range of equipment and services. No other chiropractor care facility in the Treasure Valley can
deliver the amount of state of the art, evidence-based, natural chiropractor care that we can! Visit
the best chiropractors in Boise today!

**What Are You Waiting For:**

Symptoms act as our body’s fire alarm system. Too often our health care system works to just
disguise or hide the fire instead of putting it out and rebuilding. In the beginning, we see our
role as firemen. Let’s get the fire extinguished. Let’s get you out of pain and decrease the
inflammation ravaging your body.

### [Continue Reading...][74]

**Trace:**

In the next phase, our role shifts to become an architect. We work together to develop a custom plan
that will allow us to start to rebuild those weak areas that were causing you pain and rebuild your
overall health.

**Plan:**

Our final role is one of a carpenter. Now we guide you as you do the necessary work to build optimal
function and health into your life. Because we have so many different providers and services under
one roof, we can help you achieve those goals through done-with-you programs, an integrative
approach, and the accountability that we all need to be successful.

We offer chiropractic, functional exercise, spinal decompression, deep tissue laser, shockwave, a
comprehensive gut and weight loss program, and so many other natural health services. With so many
tools at our disposal, we are able to craft a plan that focuses like a laser on your goals.

If you have [low back pain][75] that is partially coming from the spine, the muscles that support
the spine, and the discs in between the vertebrae, but you only address the spinal issue, you aren’t
going to heal as quickly or as thoroughly. Our comprehensive chiropractor care will address the
nuances of your health issue, so we not only get you feeling better faster but also keep the problem
from coming back.

**Replace:**

We have been serving Boise since 2011. In that time, we have consistently added more ways to help
more people. One of the biggest additions was our Gut Restoration Program in 2019. 8 Week to
Wellness combines nutrition, exercise, chiropractic, and supplementation, with an app for your phone
that you can track your progress to help people *Eat Well*, *Move Well* and *Think Well*.

Our chiropractor care goes beyond just helping people feel better.  We have helped people lose
weight, reverse diabetes, and get off cholesterol and blood pressure medication, to live happier,
healthier lives. This program isn’t a starvation diet. There are no magic pills or drops involved.
It is losing weight and getting healthier the right way, through a healthy diet and exercise. We do
testing before and after the program to gauge not only how much weight or how many inches you lost,

## What Makes Elevation Health Center So Different?

All disease starts with a foundational problem. Somewhere along the line, the body lost balance,
function, or the ability to heal. At Elevation Health Center, we focus on restoring health at the
cellular level – addressing the root cause, not just the symptoms.

The body is designed to be healthy. Unfortunately, sickness and disease have become so commonplace
in our society that it seems normal, but the reverse is actually true. Sickness, pain, and disease
are the body’s way of telling us something is wrong.  We believe that the power that made the body
can heal the body. We see our job as putting your body and nervous system in a position to function
properly. When that happens, the innate intelligence of the body takes over and gets you back to the
pain-free, optimally-functioning state you are meant to be in.

Our office also boasts the best [neuropathy treatment][73] Boise has to offer because of our large
range of equipment and services. No other chiropractor care facility in the Treasure Valley can
deliver the amount of state of the art, evidence-based, natural chiropractor care that we can! Visit
the best chiropractors in Boise today!

**What Are You Waiting For:**

Symptoms act as our body’s fire alarm system. Too often our health care system works to just
disguise or hide the fire instead of putting it out and rebuilding. In the beginning, we see our
role as firemen. Let’s get the fire extinguished. Let’s get you out of pain and decrease the
inflammation ravaging your body.

### [Continue Reading...][74]

**Trace:**

In the next phase, our role shifts to become an architect. We work together to develop a custom plan
that will allow us to start to rebuild those weak areas that were causing you pain and rebuild your
overall health.

**Plan:**

Our final role is one of a carpenter. Now we guide you as you do the necessary work to build optimal
function and health into your life. Because we have so many different providers and services under
one roof, we can help you achieve those goals through done-with-you programs, an integrative
approach, and the accountability that we all need to be successful.

We offer chiropractic, functional exercise, spinal decompression, deep tissue laser, shockwave, a
comprehensive gut and weight loss program, and so many other natural health services. With so many
tools at our disposal, we are able to craft a plan that focuses like a laser on your goals.

If you have [low back pain][75] that is partially coming from the spine, the muscles that support
the spine, and the discs in between the vertebrae, but you only address the spinal issue, you aren’t
going to heal as quickly or as thoroughly. Our comprehensive chiropractor care will address the
nuances of your health issue, so we not only get you feeling better faster but also keep the problem
from coming back.

**Replace:**

We have been serving Boise since 2011. In that time, we have consistently added more ways to help
more people. One of the biggest additions was our Gut Restoration Program in 2019. 8 Week to
Wellness combines nutrition, exercise, chiropractic, and supplementation, with an app for your phone
that you can track your progress to help people *Eat Well*, *Move Well* and *Think Well*.

Our chiropractor care goes beyond just helping people feel better.  We have helped people lose
weight, reverse diabetes, and get off cholesterol and blood pressure medication, to live happier,
healthier lives. This program isn’t a starvation diet. There are no magic pills or drops involved.
It is losing weight and getting healthier the right way, through a healthy diet and exercise. We do
testing before and after the program to gauge not only how much weight or how many inches you lost,
but really, how much your physiology has changed.

We treat low back pain, [headaches][76], [neck pain][77], whiplash, neuropathy, shoulder pain, knee

Integrative & Holistic Psychiatry

# Your Mental Wellness Depends on Your Whole Body—Not Just Your Brain

Feel stable, peaceful, and free enough to get & keep what you really want using my tested
whole-health integrative approach.

[Book A Call Now!][6]

Integrative & Holistic Psychiatry

# Your Mental Wellness Depends on Your Whole Body—Not Just Your Brain

Feel stable, peaceful, and free enough to get & keep what you really want using my tested
whole-health integrative approach.

[Book A Call Now!][7]

## Trusted by Patients Like You

Carolyn

…By integrating her holistic approach into my care, **I am now essentially free from daily anxiety
and my sleep has improved dramatically** … And she is great at sitting and really listening to what
her patients have to say. Within three visits and with a couple of very affordable genetic tests she
recommended, we came up with a plan that included some dietary changes and supplementation. I am
feeling better than I have in years! **[Read more…][8]**

Christina

… Happiness and laughter had been gone for a long time. But recently after making the changes
recommended I have increased energy. **I am not as depressed and I am able to wake up early and have
my devotions again. I now have the desire to exercise and make better health choices, and I am
laughing again and smiling.** I highly recommend Focus because they desire to truly help and not
just rush and prescribe pills. They really made me feel they cared. **[Read more…][9]**

Staci

… Dr. Louis identified a long term condition that **enabled me to get off an RX that I had been on
for years! **I was VERY hesitant; I probably spoke to Jeff (the office manager) at least 3 different
times for a total of 75 minutes before I pulled the trigger … peppering him with questions about the
different plans, what if it doesn’t work, sharing that I felt like I had tried everything with no
results … he was confident they could help, and he was right. Bottom line: best time and money I’ve
ever spent. Save yourself the research, skepticism, etc – and just get in there! **[Read
more…][10]**

## It’s not all in your head


For too long you’ve been told that if you could just take more medications… or take them more
consistently, or take different ones, or try therapy again… or try a different kind of therapy, it
would would all eventually snap into place and your life would make sense again. But it hasn’t
worked out that way.


You’ve tried different practitioners and therapists or you weren’t even able to find one that
understands and applies what I’m about to tell you. You see, if you’re going to build a puzzle it’s
important to make sure you have all the right pieces in place before you start. Otherwise, your
experience is going to be very frustrating and full of disappointment. For too long you’ve been
building without some *really* important pieces.


Did you know that there are over 20 different physical conditions that can show up as mental health
symptoms? You might have severe panic attacks, generalized anxiety, depression, severe mood swings,
or even auditory hallucinations caused by disorders in your body. That’s right. It’s important to
make sure your body is functioning like it should, before you start tackling mental health symptoms.


While I do provide therapy and medication management, I don’t believe it should be the goal for
everybody and for all time. I specialize in applying all missing pieces into your care. Whether it’s
your childhood experiences changing how your body responds to stress… or experiences that you’ve had
as an adult keeping you in survival mode… or how your hormones are affecting your mood… or how your
genetics are reducing the effectiveness of your medications… I go through it all. I can
also address the side effects of your medication, so you can have happier and more fulfilling
relationships. And (when the time is right) we can work towards getting you down to the lowest
medication dose possible (tapering/de-prescribing).


As your doctor, my priority is to uncover and address the hidden causes of your condition. I will
help you understand what’s taking place in your body by looking at the physical & mental conditions
that could be hindering your mental wellness. Together, we’ll make an action plan that will use all
the pieces that are important to your peace and stability using the latest specialty tests, holistic
methods, and most effective therapies for long-term healing. I aim to use the most convenient, and
most effective holistic & integrative therapies to help you feel well, happy, and hopeful again.
Let’s get started today!

[Book A Call Now!][11]

## Conditions We Treat

At **Focus Integrative Healthcare** we believe that you are so much more than a diagnosis. However,
to help you understand how we can help, here are some of the conditions that we help clients
address.
* Depression
* Anxiety
* Bipolar

## It’s not all in your head


For too long you’ve been told that if you could just take more medications… or take them more
consistently, or take different ones, or try therapy again… or try a different kind of therapy, it
would would all eventually snap into place and your life would make sense again. But it hasn’t
worked out that way.


You’ve tried different practitioners and therapists or you weren’t even able to find one that
understands and applies what I’m about to tell you. You see, if you’re going to build a puzzle it’s
important to make sure you have all the right pieces in place before you start. Otherwise, your
experience is going to be very frustrating and full of disappointment. For too long you’ve been
building without some *really* important pieces.


Did you know that there are over 20 different physical conditions that can show up as mental health
symptoms? You might have severe panic attacks, generalized anxiety, depression, severe mood swings,
or even auditory hallucinations caused by disorders in your body. That’s right. It’s important to
make sure your body is functioning like it should, before you start tackling mental health symptoms.

everybody and for all time. I specialize in applying all missing pieces into your care. Whether it’s
your childhood experiences changing how your body responds to stress… or experiences that you’ve had
as an adult keeping you in survival mode… or how your hormones are affecting your mood… or how your
genetics are reducing the effectiveness of your medications… I go through it all. I can
also address the side effects of your medication, so you can have happier and more fulfilling
relationships. And (when the time is right) we can work towards getting you down to the lowest
medication dose possible (tapering/de-prescribing).


As your doctor, my priority is to uncover and address the hidden causes of your condition. I will
help you understand what’s taking place in your body by looking at the physical & mental conditions
that could be hindering your mental wellness. Together, we’ll make an action plan that will use all
the pieces that are important to your peace and stability using the latest specialty tests, holistic
methods, and most effective therapies for long-term healing. I aim to use the most convenient, and
most effective holistic & integrative therapies to help you feel well, happy, and hopeful again.
Let’s get started today!

* Complex Post-traumatic stress disorder (cPTSD)
* Schizoaffective disorder
* Schizophrenia

Photobiomodulation (PBM) light therapy, movement-based rehabilitation, yoga, and mindfulness-based
coaching.

Our chiropractors are registered with the General Chiropractic Council (GCC) and work to regulated
professional standards. We focus on low-force chiropractic techniques, avoiding high-force manual
methods. Care is centred on restoring spinal and joint function, easing tension, and improving how
the body moves and feels. Each plan is shaped around your assessment, goals, and preferences, with a
focus on recovery, posture, and longer-term resilience.

We serve patients across Soho, Marylebone, Mayfair, Liverpool Street, and soon Canary Wharf, making

Chiropractic is a statutorily regulated healthcare profession in the UK, overseen by the General

We purchase and test hundreds of products and services each year to provide the most in-depth,
actionable product comparisons possible so you can make decisions with confidence.

171

Collective years of health and research experience in our team.

### Every article is written and reviewed by medical professionals

Our researchers and writers focus entirely on health-related products, services, and in-depth
studies. A board of medical professionals reviews our content so you can trust it completely.
Helping you make the most of your healthcare has been our business for the past 20 years.

### [What is ISSUP?][145]

We are an international network that unites, connects and shares knowledge across the substance use
workforce. We aim to make the work of our members as effective as possible through knowledge
sharing, training and networking opportunities.
[ Read more about What is ISSUP? ][146]
[

### Who is ISSUP for?

][147]
ISSUP is for everyone who is doing something to address substance use in a variety of settings. This
includes health and treatment professionals, prevention practitioners, market disruption and supply,
law enforcement, policy makers, and community-led groups like youth and volunteers.
[Join ISSUP][148]

### [What is ISSUP?][145]

We are an international network that unites, connects and shares knowledge across the substance use
workforce. We aim to make the work of our members as effective as possible through knowledge
sharing, training and networking opportunities.
[ Read more about What is ISSUP? ][146]
[

### Who is ISSUP for?

][147]
ISSUP is for everyone who is doing something to address substance use in a variety of settings. This
includes health and treatment professionals, prevention practitioners, market disruption and supply,
law enforcement, policy makers, and community-led groups like youth and volunteers.
[Join ISSUP][148]

## London’s leading therapeutic Low Level Laser Clinic.

We are experts in the application of Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT). which uses non-thermal laser,
known medically as Photobiomodulation Therapy (PBMT) and more commonly as Red Light Therapy (RLT).
We combine the use of LLLT (light wavelengths in the Infrared / IR and Near Infrared / NIR range),
to provide safe, organic, efficient healing.

[Our background][65] is unique. We are pioneers in [Red Light Therapy for Fertility][66], offering
therapy for ovarian rejuvenation and reproductive health, including endometriosis and PCOS. The
[Ovarian Rejuvenation Programme][67] is developed in collaboration with expert fertility
gynaecologists, where we combine Red Light with Ovarian PRP for women of all ages. We also lead UK
and European research in [Therapeutic Laser for Hypothyroid][68], extending proven protocols from
Turkey and Brazil, to develop our own published [lower fluency protocols][69].

Our natural health service employs outstanding medical therapeutic lasers to aid the recovery of a
wide spectrum of health conditions, including [Smoking Cessation][70]. We provide PBM Therapy for
[Oral Mucositis][71], approved by [NICE, UK][72] in 2018. Similarly we lead in the development of
Low Level Laser Therapy for inflammatory brain conditions including [Autism Spectrum Disorder
][73](ASD) and [Neurodegenerative Disease][74]. We are a [Certified Melillo Method Practitioner][75]
Centre for Functional Development Behavioural Neuroimmunology, accredited by the Interdisciplinary
Association of Functional Neurosciences and Rehabilitation ([IAFNR][76]).

Read our clinical case study series paper, published in PubMed:
[The Efficacy of Multiwavelength Red and Near-Infrared Transdermal Photobiomodulation Light Therapy
in Enhancing Female Fertility Outcomes and Improving Reproductive Health: A Prospective Case Series
with 9-Month Follow-Up][77] (Phypers et al 2024).

[Photobiomodulation in Complex Female Infertility Profile: A Case Report with 12-Month Follow-Up and
Review of Current Mechanism in Reproductive Photomedicine][78] (Phypers & Hanna 2025).

[Learn more][79]

## What we do

### Safe, organic photobiomodulation healing, with no adverse side-effects.

[Low Level Laser Therapy][80] cannot harm or burn the skin because Therapeutic Laser does not create
heat within the tissue. Instead, LLLT / PBM has an anti-inflammatory effect, improves oxygenated
blood flow and raises cellular mitochondrial energy.

The result is an improvement in tissue integrity and function. Extensive research and clinical
trials show that laser applied at low power increases the natural production of blood capillaries,
ATP, and collagen, to increase mitochondrial energy at a cellular level by around 150%.

Applications are far reaching, however at Laser Medicine we specialise in the use of
Photobiomodulation Therapy for:
* Inflammatory neurological conditions and brain health.
* Reproductive, fertility and endocrine health.
* Pain and tissue repair for musculoskeletal conditions.
* Smoking cessation, gut health and metabolic health.

[laser therapy for health optimisation]

### Ground-breaking improvements for
### fertility, Hashimoto’s and neurodegenerative conditions with red light therapy

As pioneers in [Red Light Therapy for Fertility][81], we support many people on their fertility
journey. The [Ovarian Rejuvenation Programme][82] is developed in collaboration with expert
fertility gynaecologists. Similarly we lead UK and European research into the use of [Therapeutic
Laser for Hypothyroid][83], extending clinically proven protocols from Turkey and Brazil, to
develop[ Photobiomodulation Therapy for Hashimoto’s][84] protocols of our own.

In the case of inflammatory neurodegenerative conditions, Red Light Therapy is making huge strides.
We help lots of children of all ages with [Autism Spectrum Disorders][85] (ASD), where we regular
see behavioural changes within a few sessions. We also work with the older generation to reduce
symptoms of Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s and help with recovery from Stroke

Low Level Laser Therapy also helps with smoking cessation. Many people come to Therapeutic Laser
Acupuncture techniques to experience easier withdrawal from cigarettes and vapes. We see
improvements in trauma patients particularly those with PTSD, anxiety and depression.

### Anti-inflammatory, pain reduction, and tissue rejuvenation from low level laser therapy

LLLT is recognised for its ability resolve inflammation and reduce pain. In the case of [Oral
Mucositis][86], LLLT / PBM reduces pain and inflammation during and after radiotherapy and
chemotherapy, helping to prevent and alleviate this painful condition and mitigate any long-term
side effects. Similarly LLLT is used extensively for wound healing, scar tissue, and post-surgical
healing.

For musculoskeletal health, Laser Therapy works with chronic pain and injuries, wound healing, and
nerve repair including: fibromyalgia, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, costochondritis,
post-operative wounds, back pain and sciatica, Achilles tendinitis, Plantar Fasciitis (heel pain),
tennis elbow, frozen shoulder, bone fractures neuropathy and peripheral nerve damage, Bell’s palsy
and TMJ (jaw pain).

Laser Therapy treatments are taken in combination with other physical therapy treatments, or as a
stand alone approach. Red Light Therapy can also reduce the need for anti-inflammatory and analgesic
medication.

# Low Level Laser Therapy / Photobiomodulation / Red Light Therapy.

Laser Medicine is an Independent Photobiomodulation Therapeutic Laser clinic established in 2015 in
Harley Street, London. We provide Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT) / Photobiomodulation Red Light
Therapy (PBM), for a wide range of health conditions using best in class medical laser equipment.

Our partnerships with leading researchers and medical practitioners globally, prove our continued
commitment to providing the best in Photobiomodulation Laser Therapy with Red and Near Infra Red
Light. We strive to set the standard in innovative, best-practice photobiomodulation light
therapies. We place each individual at the centre of their healing journey, and feel privileged to
support their health and wellbeing.

## London’s leading therapeutic Low Level Laser Clinic.

We are experts in the application of Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT). which uses non-thermal laser,
known medically as Photobiomodulation Therapy (PBMT) and more commonly as Red Light Therapy (RLT).
We combine the use of LLLT (light wavelengths in the Infrared / IR and Near Infrared / NIR range),
to provide safe, organic, efficient healing.

[Our background][65] is unique. We are pioneers in [Red Light Therapy for Fertility][66], offering
therapy for ovarian rejuvenation and reproductive health, including endometriosis and PCOS. The
[Ovarian Rejuvenation Programme][67] is developed in collaboration with expert fertility
gynaecologists, where we combine Red Light with Ovarian PRP for women of all ages. We also lead UK
and European research in [Therapeutic Laser for Hypothyroid][68], extending proven protocols from
Turkey and Brazil, to develop our own published [lower fluency protocols][69].

Our natural health service employs outstanding medical therapeutic lasers to aid the recovery of a
wide spectrum of health conditions, including [Smoking Cessation][70]. We provide PBM Therapy for
[Oral Mucositis][71], approved by [NICE, UK][72] in 2018. Similarly we lead in the development of
Low Level Laser Therapy for inflammatory brain conditions including [Autism Spectrum Disorder
][73](ASD) and [Neurodegenerative Disease][74]. We are a [Certified Melillo Method Practitioner][75]
Centre for Functional Development Behavioural Neuroimmunology, accredited by the Interdisciplinary
Association of Functional Neurosciences and Rehabilitation ([IAFNR][76]).

Read our clinical case study series paper, published in PubMed:
[The Efficacy of Multiwavelength Red and Near-Infrared Transdermal Photobiomodulation Light Therapy
in Enhancing Female Fertility Outcomes and Improving Reproductive Health: A Prospective Case Series
with 9-Month Follow-Up][77] (Phypers et al 2024).

[Photobiomodulation in Complex Female Infertility Profile: A Case Report with 12-Month Follow-Up and
Review of Current Mechanism in Reproductive Photomedicine][78] (Phypers & Hanna 2025).

[Learn more][79]

## What we do

### Safe, organic photobiomodulation healing, with no adverse side-effects.

[Low Level Laser Therapy][80] cannot harm or burn the skin because Therapeutic Laser does not create
heat within the tissue. Instead, LLLT / PBM has an anti-inflammatory effect, improves oxygenated
blood flow and raises cellular mitochondrial energy.

The result is an improvement in tissue integrity and function. Extensive research and clinical
trials show that laser applied at low power increases the natural production of blood capillaries,
ATP, and collagen, to increase mitochondrial energy at a cellular level by around 150%.

Applications are far reaching, however at Laser Medicine we specialise in the use of
Photobiomodulation Therapy for:
* Inflammatory neurological conditions and brain health.
* Reproductive, fertility and endocrine health.
* Pain and tissue repair for musculoskeletal conditions.
* Smoking cessation, gut health and metabolic health.

[laser therapy for health optimisation]

### Ground-breaking improvements for
### fertility, Hashimoto’s and neurodegenerative conditions with red light therapy

As pioneers in [Red Light Therapy for Fertility][81], we support many people on their fertility
journey. The [Ovarian Rejuvenation Programme][82] is developed in collaboration with expert
fertility gynaecologists. Similarly we lead UK and European research into the use of [Therapeutic
Laser for Hypothyroid][83], extending clinically proven protocols from Turkey and Brazil, to
develop[ Photobiomodulation Therapy for Hashimoto’s][84] protocols of our own.

In the case of inflammatory neurodegenerative conditions, Red Light Therapy is making huge strides.
We help lots of children of all ages with [Autism Spectrum Disorders][85] (ASD), where we regular
see behavioural changes within a few sessions. We also work with the older generation to reduce
symptoms of Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s and help with recovery from Stroke

Low Level Laser Therapy also helps with smoking cessation. Many people come to Therapeutic Laser
Acupuncture techniques to experience easier withdrawal from cigarettes and vapes. We see
improvements in trauma patients particularly those with PTSD, anxiety and depression.

### Anti-inflammatory, pain reduction, and tissue rejuvenation from low level laser therapy

LLLT is recognised for its ability resolve inflammation and reduce pain. In the case of [Oral
Mucositis][86], LLLT / PBM reduces pain and inflammation during and after radiotherapy and
chemotherapy, helping to prevent and alleviate this painful condition and mitigate any long-term
side effects. Similarly LLLT is used extensively for wound healing, scar tissue, and post-surgical
healing.

For musculoskeletal health, Laser Therapy works with chronic pain and injuries, wound healing, and
nerve repair including: fibromyalgia, osteoarthritis, sports injuries, costochondritis,
post-operative wounds, back pain and sciatica, Achilles tendinitis, Plantar Fasciitis (heel pain),
tennis elbow, frozen shoulder, bone fractures neuropathy and peripheral nerve damage, Bell’s palsy
and TMJ (jaw pain).

Laser Therapy treatments are taken in combination with other physical therapy treatments, or as a
stand alone approach. Red Light Therapy can also reduce the need for anti-inflammatory and analgesic
medication.

Chattanooga is the world’s largest manufacturer of rehabilitation equipment for treating
musculoskeletal, neurological and soft tissue disorders. For over seven decades, Chattanooga has set
a benchmark for leadership, reliability and excellence. Our products contribute to better treatment
outcomes in hospitals, clinics and home settings worldwide.

Chattanooga is a brand of Enovis. Enovis® is a world leading orthopaedic company focused on helping
people maintain and regain the joy of natural mobility. Offering a diverse portfolio of products and
solutions to prevent injury, rehabilitate muscles, bones and joints and treat pain, we strive to
help people live their lives to the fullest.

We believe that our powerful brands, comprehensive range of products, extensive distribution
network, unwavering focus on quality, innovation and customer service, and our strong relationships
with orthopaedic and physical therapy professionals have all contributed to our leading market
position. We have award winning manufacturing facilities across the globe with industry leading

Ningbo Gravity Light Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was awarded the **China National High-Tech Enterprise**
certification in 2021, backed by over 20 years of deep expertise in Gravity Light packaging and
semiconductor innovation.

Specializing in high-end Gravity Light COB technology, advanced PCB design, and comprehensive
lighting solutions, we aspire to be a globally recognized leader in premium Gravity Light light
sources. Our services go beyond product delivery — we focus on building enduring, value-driven
partnerships that continuously push the boundaries of lighting industry innovation.

From R&D to mass production, every process at Gravity Light is governed by our unwavering commitment
to precision engineering and sustainable technology development. We invest heavily in talent,
equipment, and intellectual property to ensure our clients always receive the most competitive,
reliable, and forward-thinking lighting solutions available in the global market.

collaborating with a trusted industry innovator committed to your long-term success.

💡

### Tailored Lighting Solutions

Customized Gravity Light designs for diverse applications, including bi-color, drones, fishing,
photography, smart Gravity Light, and more — engineered precisely to your specifications.

🏅

Our designs meet international standards including RoHS, CE, ETL, KC, PSE, and more, ensuring full
compliance and reliable performance across all target markets worldwide.

🌍

### Worldwide Logistics Support

Optimized supply chain management and flexible shipping solutions guarantee smooth, on-time delivery
to customers in all regions across the globe.

🔧

### Expert Technical Guidance

Ongoing technical support and professional consulting services help you grow your business
efficiently, confidently, and with the backing of 20+ years of industry expertise.

Our Advantages

## Core Competitive Advantages

What sets Gravity Light apart from the competition — built on decades of technical mastery, rigorous
quality systems, and a customer-first culture.

🔬

### Advanced COB Technology

Our proprietary high-end COB (Chip-on-Board) packaging technology delivers superior luminous
efficiency, exceptional thermal management, and outstanding color rendering — setting the benchmark
for premium lighting performance.

⚙️

### In-House PCB Design Capability

With a dedicated PCB engineering team, we develop custom circuit board designs optimized for each
lighting application — enabling faster prototyping, tighter tolerances, and seamless integration
into end products.

🏭

### State-of-the-Art Manufacturing

Our modern production facilities are equipped with automated assembly lines, precision testing
equipment, and cleanroom environments to ensure every product meets the highest international
quality standards.

📋

### Strict Quality Control System

Gravity Light executes rigorous quality control at every step — from raw material sourcing and
supply chain management to engineering design, production, and final inspection — achieving

# Restore. Reclaim. Redefine.

Personalized wellness programs and innovative technology designed to support how you feel, function,
and age gracefully.

## The Lumati Difference

Lumati brings together personalized wellness, curated retail, and innovative technology through
Return-on-Time™ — helping people around the world build lasting healthy habits, greater resilience,
and a life lived at their full potential.

[START YOUR JOURNEY ][40]
[Screenshot 2026-06-25 at 4.31.31 PM.png]

## Redefining What a Wellness Clinic Can Be

Located in Encinitas, California and Tijuana, Mexico, our personalized wellness clinics blend
cutting-edge science with time-honored traditions — delivering a precision-crafted, white-glove
wellness experience unlike anything else.

[OUR CLINICS ][41]

## We Meet You Where You Are

Lumati extends beyond our walls, connecting clinics, hospitality, and home into one seamless
wellness ecosystem. Through strategic partnerships, we bring Lumati's personalized wellness
programs, innovative technologies, and expert guidance to more people — creating elevated wellness
experiences wherever you are.

##### Our goal

###### To positively impact the wellness of one billion people by 2035.

They say it takes a village — we're building a movement.
Join the Lumati community as we redefine the future of personalized wellness, together.

[JOIN US ][44]

## Real People. Real Wellness Journeys. Real Results.

Every wellness journey is deeply personal. At Lumati, science-informed programs and intentional
experiences help people around the world live with greater awareness, longevity, and purpose.

Our Ethos

## We believe in **more life** — more energy, more healing, more time doing what matters. MedWave
## exists to give practitioners the tools to deliver measurable, life-changing outcomes.

**Photobiomodulation** (PBM) — commonly known as **red light therapy** — uses specific wavelengths
of light to stimulate cellular energy production at the mitochondrial level. It’s not new. The
science dates back over 50 years, with peer-reviewed studies confirming its safety and efficacy
across a wide range of medical and aesthetic applications.

Our Technology

## Real Science. *Real* Results.

Clinical-grade photobiomodulation — precision-engineered for measurable outcomes across every
application.

### Experience the Future of *Non-Invasive Care.*

Imagine a world where the first treatment isn’t a pill — it’s energy.

Where clinics restore how your cells function before reaching for medication. Where spas deliver
real health outcomes alongside beauty. Where wounds heal faster because we gave the body what it
needed to repair itself.

This is the future MedWave is building.

One device at a time. One practitioner at a time. One patient at a time.

Accelerated Tissue Repair Reduced Inflammation Body Contouring & Fat Loss Chronic Pain Relief
Collagen Stimulation Neurological Support Improved Circulation Wound Healing
