MedWave puts proven photobiomodulation science to work in your practice — with clinical-grade
devices designed and built in South Africa, engineered with premium European components, and
supported by local service and parts.

Our Ethos

## We believe in **more life** — more energy, more healing, more time doing what matters. MedWave
## exists to give practitioners the tools to deliver measurable, life-changing outcomes.

**Photobiomodulation** (PBM) — commonly known as **red light therapy** — uses specific wavelengths
of light to stimulate cellular energy production at the mitochondrial level. It’s not new. The
science dates back over 50 years, with peer-reviewed studies confirming its safety and efficacy
across a wide range of medical and aesthetic applications.

Our Technology

## Real Science. *Real* Results.

Clinical-grade photobiomodulation — precision-engineered for measurable outcomes across every
application.

### Experience the Future of *Non-Invasive Care.*

Imagine a world where the first treatment isn’t a pill — it’s energy.

Where clinics restore how your cells function before reaching for medication. Where spas deliver
real health outcomes alongside beauty. Where wounds heal faster because we gave the body what it
needed to repair itself.

This is the future MedWave is building.

One device at a time. One practitioner at a time. One patient at a time.

Accelerated Tissue Repair Reduced Inflammation Body Contouring & Fat Loss Chronic Pain Relief
Collagen Stimulation Neurological Support Improved Circulation Wound Healing

The HyperVibe whole body vibration plate is the perfect complement to MedWave photobiomodulation.
While PBM activates cellular repair at the mitochondrial level, whole body vibration amplifies the
results — boosting circulation, promoting lymphatic drainage, and increasing oxygen delivery to
treated tissue.

Research shows whole body vibration increases oxygen consumption by approximately 22% and energy
expenditure by approximately 20% — accelerating the body’s response to photobiomodulation and
enhancing outcomes across pain management, body contouring, and recovery.

Together, they create a complete clinical protocol that delivers faster, more measurable results —
from a single treatment room.

receptor in the skin, and generates a particular biological effect depending on its penetration.

# La photobiomodulation
# par Milta Technologie

Milta est un pionnier dans le domaine de la photobiomodulation, dédié à l’innovation et la qualité.
Explorez nos dispositifs qui offrent des solutions avancées et fiables pour les professionnels du
soin par la lumière.

[PremDrive rallye touristique en Provence]

## La photobiomodulation
## (PBM)

La PBM agit principalement au niveau des mitochondries des cellules, favorisant la production d’ATP,
une molécule énergétique essentielle, et activant divers mécanismes de réparation cellulaire et de
croissance tissulaire.

[milta 2024][milta 2024]
[led milta][led milta]

## Les technologies
## Milta

Le dispositif Milta intègre des technologies de pointe, comme le laser froid nano-pulsé et des LED.
Ces technologies favorisent une application efficace de la photobiomodulation, améliorant les
résultats obtenus lors des séances. Milta continue de se démarquer par son innovation constante,
fusionnant des avancées technologiques pour renforcer les capacités de ses dispositifs.

[Découvrez le concept Milta][1]

## applications
## de la photobiomodulation

La photobiomodulation offre une gamme étendue d’applications, notamment dans la diminution de
l’inflammation et la régénération tissulaire. Le dispositif Milta est utilisé dans diverses
situations professionnelles pour soutenir ces processus, adaptant ses fonctions pour répondre à des
besoins spécifiques en matière de soins et de récupération.

### **Soins support**

Aide à gérer la douleur et favorise la cicatrisation pour un soutien continu.

### **Esthétique**

Améliore l’apparence de la peau, réduit les rides et augmente l’élasticité.

### **Gynécologique**

Soutient les conditions gynécologiques avec une approche non invasive pour le bien-être féminin.

### **Médecine du sport**

Accélère la récupération des blessures et améliore la performance sportive.

### ****Dentisterie****

Favorise la cicatrisation et réduit l’inconfort après les interventions dentaires.

### ****Science du cheveu****

Stimule la croissance des cheveux et améliore la santé du cuir chevelu.

## Études  
## scientifiques

Retrouvez plusieurs études confirmant les bénéfices et l’innovation apportés par la
photobiomodulation, une technique non invasive basée sur la lumière pour activer les processus
biologiques, cette méthode a démontré des effets positifs significatifs dans de nombreuses
applications médicales et esthétiques. Ces recherches soulignent l’efficacité de notre technologie
pour améliorer la qualité de vie et reflètent notre engagement envers une recherche scientifique
rigoureuse.

[Études scientifiques][2]
[etudes milta][etudes milta]
[etudes milta][etudes milta]

## Formation
## et support

Milta offre des programmes de formation complets pour les nouveaux utilisateurs, assurant une prise
en main efficace du dispositif. Un support technique dédié est également disponible, reflétant
l’engagement de Milta à fournir une assistance continue aux professionnels de la santé.

## Derniers articles
## de blog

[photobiomodulation rosacée][photobiomodulation rosacée]
Soins de la peau

Par Vanessa , le 9 avril 2026

La rosacée s’exprime souvent sur la peau du visage par des rougeurs diffuses, parfois persistantes.
Cette sensibilité cutanée peut évoluer avec le temps et devenir difficile à stabiliser. Dans cette
recherche d’équilibre, la photobiomodulation par LEDs apparaît comme une approche douce, basée sur
l’exposition de la peau à une lumière contrôlée.

La photobiomodulation repose sur un principe simple : l’application d’une lumière douce,

# La photobiomodulation
# par Milta Technologie

Milta est un pionnier dans le domaine de la photobiomodulation, dédié à l’innovation et la qualité.
Explorez nos dispositifs qui offrent des solutions avancées et fiables pour les professionnels du
soin par la lumière.

[PremDrive rallye touristique en Provence]

## La photobiomodulation
## (PBM)

La PBM agit principalement au niveau des mitochondries des cellules, favorisant la production d’ATP,
une molécule énergétique essentielle, et activant divers mécanismes de réparation cellulaire et de
croissance tissulaire.

[milta 2024][milta 2024]
[led milta][led milta]

## Les technologies
## Milta

Le dispositif Milta intègre des technologies de pointe, comme le laser froid nano-pulsé et des LED.
Ces technologies favorisent une application efficace de la photobiomodulation, améliorant les
résultats obtenus lors des séances. Milta continue de se démarquer par son innovation constante,
fusionnant des avancées technologiques pour renforcer les capacités de ses dispositifs.

[Découvrez le concept Milta][1]

## applications
## de la photobiomodulation

La photobiomodulation offre une gamme étendue d’applications, notamment dans la diminution de
l’inflammation et la régénération tissulaire. Le dispositif Milta est utilisé dans diverses
situations professionnelles pour soutenir ces processus, adaptant ses fonctions pour répondre à des
besoins spécifiques en matière de soins et de récupération.

### **Soins support**

Aide à gérer la douleur et favorise la cicatrisation pour un soutien continu.

### **Esthétique**

Améliore l’apparence de la peau, réduit les rides et augmente l’élasticité.

### **Gynécologique**

Soutient les conditions gynécologiques avec une approche non invasive pour le bien-être féminin.

### **Médecine du sport**

Accélère la récupération des blessures et améliore la performance sportive.

### ****Dentisterie****

Favorise la cicatrisation et réduit l’inconfort après les interventions dentaires.

### ****Science du cheveu****

Stimule la croissance des cheveux et améliore la santé du cuir chevelu.

## Études  
## scientifiques

Retrouvez plusieurs études confirmant les bénéfices et l’innovation apportés par la
photobiomodulation, une technique non invasive basée sur la lumière pour activer les processus
biologiques, cette méthode a démontré des effets positifs significatifs dans de nombreuses
applications médicales et esthétiques. Ces recherches soulignent l’efficacité de notre technologie
pour améliorer la qualité de vie et reflètent notre engagement envers une recherche scientifique
rigoureuse.

[Études scientifiques][2]

## Formation
## et support

Milta offre des programmes de formation complets pour les nouveaux utilisateurs, assurant une prise
en main efficace du dispositif. Un support technique dédié est également disponible, reflétant
l’engagement de Milta à fournir une assistance continue aux professionnels de la santé.

* Supports management of treatment toxicity

# The **Caring Light**
# for Phototherapy

Thanks to its front-line anatomic medical devices, NeoMedLight will:
* Spread the usage of Photobiomodulation to limit side effects and increase therapeutic efficiency
  in cancer treatment
* Broaden the scope of Photobiomodulation to additional therapeutic targets in specialty wound care
* Provide a cost-effective and hospital compatible solution integrated in the therapeutic practice

NeoMedLight is certified ISO 13485.

NeoMedLight is engaged in treating and preventing mucositis and dermatitis, a huge unmet clinical
need.

[ Contact us ][24]

# CareMin**650**
# Our New Innovation

An unrivalled medical device for severe cancer treatment complications: exact & easy red-LED
photobiomodulation for mucositis and dermatitis.
* Safe treatment without side effects
* Comfortable and painless
* Less costly treatment alternative to laser therapy

[ Read more ][25]
[CareMin650]

# About **us**

NML aims to change the field of phototherapy with a novel way to deliver therapeutic light. Based on
the company unique approach to emitting light, PhotoBioModulation, a novel way to heal using light,
will develop into a front line therapeutic tool for specialty wound care.

After its first step in neonatal jaundice, NeoMedLight’s primary focus is the treatment trough
photobiomodulation of mucositis and dermatitis induced by chemo/radiotherapy.

Once established in that field, NeoMedLight will expend the field of indication and the range of
therapeutic protocols to reach into other specialty wound care such as pressure ulcers, or diabetic
wounds.

NeoMedLight has conceived and developed fiber-optic phototherapy devices to treat neonatal jaundice;
as well as mucositis, dermatitis. Future projects include other specialty wound care such as
pressure ulcers.

[ Learn more ][34]

# Program **H2020**

NeoMedLight is proud to be the recipient from a EU grant through the program H2020.

This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation
programme under grant agreement N°858849.

NeoMedLight is also an ISO 13485 certified company.

[European Commission logo]
[[NeoMedLight]][35]

NeoMedLight develops innovative medical devices targeted at a better delivery of phototherapy. The
company benefits from a novel, unique and proprietary technology allowing the emission of light
through woven optic fibers.

# Redefining Red Light Therapy for Care Providers

## **Experience Transformative Outcomes**


[NeuroCare Pro® Pulsed Light Medical Technology® (PLMT®)]

Not all red light therapy is created equal. Neurocare Pro equips healthcare providers with
clinically driven Pulsed Light Medical Technology (PLMT) systems powered by our proprietary Diode
Web Technology™ delivering up to 4 synchronized red and near-infrared wavelengths of light
simultaneously through advanced frequency clustering algorithms. As an FDA-registered Class II
medical device manufacturer, Neurocare Pro designs precision-engineered systems to support natural
healing, recovery, and optimized patient outcomes. We are driven by efficacy, not profit.

## Why Neurocare Pro PLMT Is Different…

**NeurocarePro’s Pulsed Light Medical Technology (PLMT)** is where **light therapy meets targeted
frequency medicine**, surpassing traditional red-light and NIR devices that typically focus on a
single chromophore. PLMT utilizes multi-spectral, polychromatic red and NIR light with proprietary
Nogier and Solfeggio frequency algorithms to **stimulate multiple cellular targets simultaneously**,
including mitochondria and neural networks. This systems-level approach effectively addresses
complex, multi-factorial conditions rather than just superficial symptoms….

[NeuroCare Pro® Pulsed Light Medical Technology® (PLMT®)]

Not all red light therapy is created equal. Neurocare Pro equips healthcare providers with

healing, recovery, and optimized patient outcomes. We are driven by efficacy, not profit.

## Why Neurocare Pro PLMT Is Different…

**NeurocarePro’s Pulsed Light Medical Technology (PLMT)** is where **light therapy meets targeted
frequency medicine**, surpassing traditional red-light and NIR devices that typically focus on a
single chromophore. PLMT utilizes multi-spectral, polychromatic red and NIR light with proprietary
Nogier and Solfeggio frequency algorithms to **stimulate multiple cellular targets simultaneously**,
including mitochondria and neural networks. This systems-level approach effectively addresses
complex, multi-factorial conditions rather than just superficial symptoms….

### NEUWiederholer-RABATTfür Absolventen externer Grundkurse

Wir freuen uns über das wachsende Interesse an unserer Neurofeedback-Zertifizierung und unseren
Neurofeedback-Workshops. Um diesem Interesse gerecht zu werden, erweitern wir unser Angebot:

#### Ab sofort können auch Absolventen externer Grundkurse von unserem Wiederholer-Rabatt
#### profitieren

 

### VERTIEFEN

Sie Ihre Kenntnisse im Bereich Neurofeedback auf einem fortgeschrittenen Niveau

### PROFITIEREN

Sie von unserem praxisorientierten und innovativen Kursangebot

### LERNEN

Sie modernste Methoden wie QEEG kennen und anwenden

### SPAREN

Sie durch den Wiederholer-Rabatt  - auch für Absolventen externer Grundkurse

# Shed Some Light
# *On The Brain.*

NeuroThera pioneers transcranial photobiomodulation — delivering near-infrared laser light directly
to targeted brain regions to treat the neurological conditions that disable hundreds of millions
worldwide.

**NeuroThera** uses science, research, and innovation to pioneer the application of **light energy**
in the treatment of neurological conditions — building the world's first clinical-grade transcranial
photobiomodulation platform.

The Problem

## A Crisis Measured
## in Trillions

Neurological and psychiatric conditions represent the most devastating — and most underfunded —
disease categories in medicine. These are not rare diseases. They are the leading drivers of human
disability, economic loss, and premature death worldwide.

Current neurorehabilitation options are severely limited in access and efficacy
>$793B

### Combined Annual U.S. Economic Burden Across NeuroThera's Five Target Indications

These five conditions — MDD, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, TBI, and Stroke — collectively account for
nearly $800 billion in annual U.S. economic losses. NeuroThera's tPBM platform is uniquely
positioned across all five through a single, validated, non-invasive mechanism of action.

The Solution

## A Multi-Indication
## Neuromodulation Platform

NeuroThera's transcranial photobiomodulation (tPBM) system is not a single-indication device — it is
a platform. One mechanism of action, one device architecture, multiple neurological indications.
This is the first time a safe, non-invasive brain stimulation technology has demonstrated
multi-indication potential across validated imaging biomarkers.

🧠

#### One Platform, Five Indications

A single near-infrared laser device configurable for MDD, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, TBI, and
post-stroke rehabilitation — dramatically reducing development cost per indication.

🔬

#### Biologically Validated Mechanism

tPBM activates mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase in neurons, producing dose-dependent changes in
cerebral blood flow, metabolism, and cortical activity — confirmed across BOLD fMRI, FDG-PET, and
EEG simultaneously.

⚡

#### No Systemic Side Effects

Unlike drugs, tPBM acts locally on targeted brain regions with zero serious adverse events across
all clinical trials to date. No polypharmacy. No titration. No systemic toxicity.

🏥

#### Clinic-Ready, Portable Form Factor

No dedicated treatment room required. Sessions run 5–15 minutes, 2–3× per week. Designed to deploy
in mental health clinics, neurology practices, and primary care settings without infrastructure
investment.

# Shed Some Light
# *On The Brain.*

NeuroThera pioneers transcranial photobiomodulation — delivering near-infrared laser light directly
to targeted brain regions to treat the neurological conditions that disable hundreds of millions
worldwide.

[Explore the Platform][7] [Clinical Evidence][8]
scroll

**NeuroThera** uses science, research, and innovation to pioneer the application of **light energy**
in the treatment of neurological conditions — building the world's first clinical-grade transcranial
photobiomodulation platform.

The Problem

## A Crisis Measured
## in Trillions

Neurological and psychiatric conditions represent the most devastating — and most underfunded —
disease categories in medicine. These are not rare diseases. They are the leading drivers of human
disability, economic loss, and premature death worldwide.

Major Depressive Disorder
Depression
$382B
Annual U.S. Economic Burden (2023 USD)
**280 million** people affected worldwide
Leading cause of disability globally; **#1 contributor to DALYs** among mental health conditions
**30–50%** of patients fail first-line antidepressants
274.8M new cases identified globally in 2019 — a **59% increase** since 1990
Alzheimer's Disease
Alzheimer's & Dementia
$243B
Annual U.S. Economic Burden
**55 million** people live with dementia globally; projected **78 million by 2030**
**7.2 million** Americans currently affected; 8.5M projected by 2030
No disease-modifying therapy stops or reverses cognitive decline
Family caregiving costs exceed **$230B annually** in the U.S. alone
Parkinson's Disease
Parkinson's Disease
$61.5B
Annual U.S. Economic Burden
**11.77 million** cases worldwide; projected to reach **25 million by 2050**
1.2 million Americans currently living with PD; **90,000 new diagnoses** annually
Cases set to **double** within a generation driven by global aging
Current therapies manage symptoms only — no neuroprotective treatment exists
Traumatic Brain Injury
TBI & Concussion
$50B
Annual U.S. Economic Burden
**2.87 million** ED visits annually; **69,473** TBI-related deaths (2021)
**3.2–5.3 million** Americans living with long-term TBI-related disability
**18.2%** of U.S. adults have experienced a TBI with loss of consciousness
**Zero FDA-approved** pharmacotherapies for TBI recovery exist today
Stroke & Neurorehabilitation
Post-Stroke Recovery
$56.5B
Annual U.S. Economic Burden (2019–2020)
**795,000 strokes** annually in the U.S.; ~7.6 million survivors living with disability
Incident strokes increased **70%** over the past three decades
**87%** of all strokes are ischemic — majority survive with significant rehabilitation need
Current neurorehabilitation options are severely limited in access and efficacy
>$793B

### Combined Annual U.S. Economic Burden Across NeuroThera's Five Target Indications

These five conditions — MDD, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, TBI, and Stroke — collectively account for
nearly $800 billion in annual U.S. economic losses. NeuroThera's tPBM platform is uniquely
positioned across all five through a single, validated, non-invasive mechanism of action.

The Solution

## A Multi-Indication
## Neuromodulation Platform

NeuroThera's transcranial photobiomodulation (tPBM) system is not a single-indication device — it is
a platform. One mechanism of action, one device architecture, multiple neurological indications.
This is the first time a safe, non-invasive brain stimulation technology has demonstrated
multi-indication potential across validated imaging biomarkers.

🧠

#### One Platform, Five Indications

A single near-infrared laser device configurable for MDD, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, TBI, and
post-stroke rehabilitation — dramatically reducing development cost per indication.

🔬

#### Biologically Validated Mechanism

tPBM activates mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase in neurons, producing dose-dependent changes in
cerebral blood flow, metabolism, and cortical activity — confirmed across BOLD fMRI, FDG-PET, and
EEG simultaneously.

⚡

#### No Systemic Side Effects

Unlike drugs, tPBM acts locally on targeted brain regions with zero serious adverse events across
all clinical trials to date. No polypharmacy. No titration. No systemic toxicity.

🏥

#### Clinic-Ready, Portable Form Factor

No dedicated treatment room required. Sessions run 5–15 minutes, 2–3× per week. Designed to deploy
in mental health clinics, neurology practices, and primary care settings without infrastructure
investment.

#### Stroke & Neurorehabilitation

Technology

## How Transcranial
## Photobiomodulation Works

See the Technology Applied — Harvard/MGH

[ [How Transcranial Photobiomodulation (tPBM) Works] Watch on YouTube ↗ ][9]
1

#### Photon Penetration

Near-infrared wavelength — specifically selected for optimal tissue penetration — passes through
scalp and skull to reach targeted cortical regions without heating tissue.

2

#### Mitochondrial Activation

Photons are absorbed by cytochrome c oxidase (CCO) in neuronal mitochondria, triggering enhanced ATP
production, reduced oxidative stress, and restored cellular energy metabolism.

3

#### Cerebral Blood Flow Modulation

Dose-dependent changes in regional cerebral blood flow are confirmed by BOLD fMRI. Effects extend
globally — beyond directly irradiated regions — via neural network connectivity.

4

#### Metabolic Enhancement & Neuroplasticity

FDG-PET imaging confirms increased glucose uptake in prefrontal cortex. Enhanced synaptic function
and neuronal connectivity in mood-regulating circuits support lasting clinical benefit.

Clinical Validation

## Rigorously Proven.
## Triple-Validated.

NeuroThera's tPBM technology has been evaluated in multiple NIH-funded clinical trials at
Harvard/MGH, NYU, and international sites — producing results that exceed existing neuromodulation
benchmarks with an exemplary safety profile.

[Harvard Medical School and MGH]
Harvard Medical School · Massachusetts General Hospital
[NYU School of Medicine]
NYU School of Medicine · NYU Langone Medical Center
[Nathan S. Kline Institute]
Nathan S. Kline Institute for Psychiatric Research
[Peruvian Clinical Research]
Peruvian Clinical Research · Lima, Peru
🏆

### Industry-First: Triple Biomarker Validation

NeuroThera is the **only** transcranial photobiomodulation company in the world with clinical
efficacy independently validated across three simultaneous imaging biomarkers — making our evidence
package unprecedented in the tPBM field.

BOLD fMRI · Cerebral Blood Flow FDG-PET · Cerebral Metabolism EEG · Cortical Activity Zero Serious
Adverse Events
Why NeuroThera

## The Competitive Advantage

💡

### Laser vs. LED

NeuroThera uses a coherent laser — not LED panels. Laser delivers consistent, high-power-density
energy to precisely targeted brain regions. LED competitors cannot match tissue penetration depth or
reproducibility.

📊

### NIH-Validated Science

Over $10 million in NIH and Gates Foundation non-dilutive grants provides government-level
validation of scientific merit — something no competitor in the tPBM space can claim at this scale.

⚖️

### 22 Issued Patents

20 U.S. patents and 2 Japanese patents covering transcranial photobiomodulation applications, with
13+ applications pending — creating a durable IP moat across indications and device configurations.

🌐

### Multi-Indication Design

One device. Five indications. The platform architecture was designed from inception to address
multiple neurological conditions — accelerating time-to-market for each subsequent indication after
FDA clearance.

## The Team Behind
## the Science

NeuroThera combines deep clinical expertise, regulatory experience, and commercial execution
capability — with direct ties to the physicians conducting the science.

PN

#### Paul Nielsen

Chief Executive Officer
Senior technology and healthcare executive with 25+ years of leadership across life sciences, AI,
and value-based care. At UnitedHealth Group, generated $1.4B+ through strategic partnerships and
next-generation care delivery. Former CEO of Proxim; took SeaChange International from startup to
IPO in 3.5 years.
LT

#### Luis De Taboada

CTO & Co-Founder
Globally recognized authority in transcranial laser therapy. Former VP R&D at PhotoThera. Holds
extensive tPBM patent portfolio.
DH

#### Dallas C. Hack, MD

Chief Scientific Officer
Veterans & Military Affairs
COL (Ret.), USA. Concussion specialist with extensive military medicine experience in TBI research
and neuromodulation treatment.
RB

#### Rhonda Robinson Beale, MD

Chief Medical Officer
Payer & Provider Affairs
30+ years healthcare executive. Former SVP & Deputy CMO at UnitedHealth Group. Expert in payer
strategy and coverage policy.
ER

#### Eric Rock

VP Quality, Regulatory & Compliance
Medical device quality and FDA regulatory expert. ISO 13485 and FDA submission experience at B&W Tek
Medical.
DM

#### Doug Mayer

VP Sales & Marketing
15+ years in photobiomodulation commercialization. Built LiteCure's commercial teams and drove
category adoption across the therapeutic laser market.
KOLs & Advisors

### Key Opinion Leaders & Scientific Advisors

Founders recognized as global experts in photobiomodulation, healthcare transformation leaders, and
the principal investigators behind our clinical program.

PC

#### Paolo Cassano, MD, PhD

Principal Investigator · Harvard/MGH
Assistant Professor of Psychiatry, Harvard Medical School. Director, Brain Photobiomodulation Clinic
at MGH. PI on TRIADE Phase I & II trials.
DI

#### Dan Iosifescu, MD, MSc

Clinical Collaborator · NYU
Professor of Psychiatry, NYU Grossman School of Medicine. Director, Clinical & Translational
Neuroscience, Nathan Kline Institute. Co-investigator on TRIADE trials.
BP

#### Brian Pryor, PhD

Co-Founder & Director
CEO of BWTek Medical. LiteCure founder and CEO; founded 5 medical device companies. Fellow and Board
Member of ASLMS.
SW

#### Sean Wang, PhD

Co-Founder & Director
Founder of B&W Tek. Fellow of OSA, SPIE, and ASLMS. Holds 60+ patents in optical instruments and
medical devices. Serial entrepreneur.
GC

#### Garry Choy, MD, MBA

Advisor · UnitedHealth Group
Chief Clinical Transformation Officer, UnitedHealth Group. Expert in healthcare system innovation,
AI-driven clinical workflows, and value-based care implementation.
JA

#### Juanita Anders, PhD

Scientific Advisor · USU
Professor at Uniformed Services University. Leading NIH-funded researcher in photobiomodulation and
neural tissue repair. Pioneer in laser therapy applications for the nervous system.

## Ready to Learn More?

Whether you are a clinician, investor, health system leader, or research partner — we want to
connect. NeuroThera is building the future of non-invasive brain therapy.

# Move better. Recover fully. Build resilience.

Thoughtful care grounded in a thorough assessment, designed to reduce pain, restore movement, and
support long-term health.

## Care shouldn’t feel confusing or rushed.

Ongoing pain, recurring injuries, or uncertainty about your next step can feel frustrating and
overwhelming. Many people come to us after trying different approaches without gaining clarity or
meaningful progress.

At ONE80 Health, we take the time to understand what’s going on, so your care is thoughtful, clear,
and intentional.

## Comprehensive Assessment

We take time to understand how your body moves, compensates, and responds, identifying the true
contributors to your symptoms.

## Integrated Therapies

[Advanced rehabilitation technology used thoughtfully as part of an integrated care approach at
ONE80 Health.]

Care may include manual therapy, rehabilitation, and advanced technologies, applied intentionally,
not generically.

## Clear Plan & Progression

[Clinician explaining a personalized recovery plan using visual tools at ONE80 Health.]

You’ll understand what we’re doing, why it matters, and how your care evolves as your body adapts.

## Built for Long-Term Outcomes

[Patient demonstrating confident, controlled movement following rehabilitation at ONE80 Health.]

Our goal is not just symptom relief, it’s helping you move forward with confidence and resilience.

## Conditions We Commonly Support

We work with a wide range of pain, injury, and movement-related concerns from acute injuries to
complex, long-standing conditions.

Care is guided by a thorough understanding of how your body is functioning, not a one-size-fits-all
diagnosis.

[ [one80-health-back-neck-spine-pain-assessment.jpg] ][140]

### **Back, Neck & Spine Pain**

### *Neck pain, low back pain, sciatica, disc-related symptoms*

[ [Clinician discussing headache and dizziness symptoms during a neurological assessment at ONE80
Health] ][141]

### **Headaches, Dizziness & Concussion**

### Concussion recovery, migraines, dizziness, vertigo

[ [Sports rehabilitation session focused on overuse and activity-related injuries at ONE80 Health]
][142]

### **Sports & Soft Tissue Injuries**

### *Overuse injuries, tendinopathies, training-related pain*

# Our Services

Our services span chiropractic care, rehabilitation, manual therapy, advanced therapeutic
technologies, and movement-based care.

Rather than applying a preset treatment, care is selected based on how your body is functioning,
what it needs now, and where you’re trying to get.

[ Learn how we work ][143]

in Toronto.]

Toronto, ON M5R 2A5

Monday–Thursday: 8am–6pm

**Our Approach**

We take a thoughtful, assessment-first approach to care, guided by your presentation, stage of
recovery, and goals.

Our focus is on clarity, appropriate progression, and long-term outcomes.

## What is Outliyr?

Outliyr is a **health optimization platform and research hub for high performers**, founded in 2018
by Nick Urban, host of the High Performance Longevity podcast. The methodology is verification
instead of description: members log their supplements, devices, and protocols, then test them
against their own baseline data through structured self-experiments, with every answer graded
Experimental, Under test, or Confirmed. The platform sits on top of 380+ evidence-based research
guides, 270+ expert interviews, 150+ BioHarmony intervention ratings, and a suite of free health
optimization tools, all grounded in 14+ years of first-hand testing. BioHarmony is Outliyr’s
evaluation framework: it weighs an intervention’s downsides as heavily as its upsides across
multiple lenses of evidence. Outliyr serves data-literate people optimizing everything from daily
energy to longevity, and it works with or without a wearable.

instead of description: members log their supplements, devices, and protocols, then test them
against their own baseline data through structured self-experiments, with every answer graded
Experimental, Under test, or Confirmed. The platform sits on top of 380+ evidence-based research

evaluation framework: it weighs an intervention’s downsides as heavily as its upsides across
multiple lenses of evidence. Outliyr serves data-literate people optimizing everything from daily
energy to longevity, and it works with or without a wearable.

The PBM Foundation supports and coordinates scientific and clinical efforts, and raises awareness,
for light technology treating patients with COVID-19, cancer, chronic pain, opioid use disorder, and
neurological conditions.

## ADVOCACY

Named the 2026 Global Health Innovation Advocate of the Year, the Foundation collaborates with
scientists, practitioners, and government officials to expand acceptance and application of PBM.
This includes facilitating collaborative research, publicizing clinical evidence, and promoting
policy and programmatic changes. Foundation board members and advisors have presented to the White
House, Executive Branch Agencies, Congress, Medical and Policy Forums, and the United Nations.

**[Learn more»][65]**

[PBM Basics - knee pain]

## PBM BASICS

Learn about the science and application of Photobiomodulation (PBM), successfully treating COVID-19,
Opioid Use Disorder (OUD), and traumatic brain injury (TBI); managing pain; healing wounds;
preventing Cancer therapy’s side-effects; and helping our Military. Over 100 million patients have
received PBM in clinical settings proving PBM effective and safe.

[**Learn More»**][66]

[PBM Research]

## RESEARCH

The Foundation funds and coordinates PBM research around the world.  We share our research with
healthcare leaders and senior policy officials. Evidence of PBM’s successful treatments supports
expanding insurance coverage, treatment protocols, and order sets so patients receive the full
benefit of PBM therapy.

[**Learn More»**][67]

[PBM Education - auditorium]

## EDUCATION

The Foundation supports establishing degree and certification programs for using PBM to treat
patients. We work with medical and nursing schools to support curriculum development, learning
module design, and faculty recruitment. There are now formal medical and nursing degrees for PBM
with more to come!

[**Learn More»**][68]

Support PBM’s efforts to develop pain management alternatives to opioids using light therapy.

[MAKE A DONATION][69]

The PBM Foundation supports and coordinates scientific and clinical efforts, and raises awareness,
for light technology treating patients with COVID-19, cancer, chronic pain, opioid use disorder, and
neurological conditions.

## ADVOCACY

Named the 2026 Global Health Innovation Advocate of the Year, the Foundation collaborates with
scientists, practitioners, and government officials to expand acceptance and application of PBM.
This includes facilitating collaborative research, publicizing clinical evidence, and promoting
policy and programmatic changes. Foundation board members and advisors have presented to the White
House, Executive Branch Agencies, Congress, Medical and Policy Forums, and the United Nations.

**[Learn more»][65]**

[PBM Basics - knee pain]

## PBM BASICS

Learn about the science and application of Photobiomodulation (PBM), successfully treating COVID-19,
Opioid Use Disorder (OUD), and traumatic brain injury (TBI); managing pain; healing wounds;
preventing Cancer therapy’s side-effects; and helping our Military. Over 100 million patients have
received PBM in clinical settings proving PBM effective and safe.

[**Learn More»**][66]

[PBM Research]

## RESEARCH

The Foundation funds and coordinates PBM research around the world.  We share our research with
healthcare leaders and senior policy officials. Evidence of PBM’s successful treatments supports
expanding insurance coverage, treatment protocols, and order sets so patients receive the full
benefit of PBM therapy.

[**Learn More»**][67]

[PBM Education - auditorium]

## EDUCATION

The Foundation supports establishing degree and certification programs for using PBM to treat
patients. We work with medical and nursing schools to support curriculum development, learning
module design, and faculty recruitment. There are now formal medical and nursing degrees for PBM
with more to come!

[**Learn More»**][68]

Support PBM’s efforts to develop pain management alternatives to opioids using light therapy.

[MAKE A DONATION][69]

## Light Therapy

## A proven healing technology  for a healthy life

Photobiomodulation also known as red light therapy or low level laser therapy studies the biological
reactions to specific light wavelengths exposure. Light absorption triggers reactions at the cell
level by boosting mitochondria activity. Years of studies have shown that effects include:
* pain relief
* improved blood flow
* soft and hard tissue regeneration
* metabolism regulation

Applications are proven in fields as diverse as dentistry, oncology, diabetes, mental health and
general wellness.

As a completely natural way of healing, photobiomodulation can be used as a complement with
traditional treatments or as a substitute.

## Our devices

## Universal high quality devices

With strong scientific and engineering expertise, PBM’s vision is to bring photobiomodulation out of
the labs or professional practices and make it available to all including animals.

Our devices are powered by the world-leading scientists and doctors of light therapy in the industry
and inspired by over 20 years of scientific  research, innovation and clinical study.

They are the results of a fully controlled design backed by scientific proofs and uncompromising
engineering to bring the most efficient and reliable devices for humans and animals including dogs,
cats and horses.

They are the most tested and trusted light therapy devices in the market, backed by over 20 years of
scientific research, have been clinically proven and well established in the clinical dental, human,
pet and horse therapy.

PBM strives to continuously enhance its devices based on the latest photobiomodulation research and
develop new applications.

Our products are the results of multiyear research with worldwide specialists in photobiomodulation.

connectivity, and alleviate symptoms associated with Post-Concussion Syndrome, dizziness, migraines,
balance, and many other neurological challenges.

doctors. Our doctors provide non-pharmaceutical and non-invasive brain training founded on the
concept that the brain is capable of learning and changing, with nearly limitless potential,
throughout life. This concept has been termed “neuroplasticity”. Plasticity Brain Centers can
improve the neurological performance and quality of life of patients with brain injuries and
neurological disorders.

### RegenAxis Spine

RegenAxis Spine focuses on restoring strength and stability to the structures that support your
entire body. Using advanced regenerative therapies and precision-guided procedures, our physicians
treat common causes of back and neck pain without defaulting to surgery. The goal is simple: reduce
inflammation, support healing, and help you move confidently again.

### RegenAxis Joint

RegenAxis Joint is designed for patients who want to stay active without living around knee,
shoulder, hip, or elbow pain. Our team uses biologic therapies such as PRP and stem cell–derived
treatments to support joint health from within. Every plan is tailored to your lifestyle, mobility
goals, and long-term function.

### RegenAxis Nerve

RegenAxis Nerve targets pain that originates from irritated, compressed, or inflamed nerves. Whether
symptoms include radiating pain, numbness, tingling, or burning sensations, our physicians use
regenerative and precision-based approaches to calm the nerve and restore comfort. The focus is
long-term relief that protects movement—not temporary masking.

RegenAxis Disc is built for patients dealing with disc-related pain, including bulging discs,
herniations, and degenerative disc disease. Our regenerative-first approach supports the disc
environment through advanced biologics and minimally invasive procedures. The goal is to reduce pain
at its origin, improve function, and help you avoid surgery whenever possible.

[Regenerative Medicine icon]

### Regenerative Medicine

Regenerative medicine uses your body’s own healing potential to support repair in injured or
degenerating tissue. At Regen Axis Health, we use science-backed treatments like PRP, shockwave
therapy, and regenerative laser to reduce inflammation, restore function, and help you return to
movement—without relying on steroids or surgery.

[Learn More About Regenerative Medicine][159]

[Stem Cell Therapy icon]

### Stem Cell Therapy

Stem cell–derived treatments are designed to support tissue repair at a deeper level, especially in
joints, tendons, and spine-related conditions. Regen Axis Health offers physician-led therapies
using biologics from bone marrow or adipose tissue, selected based on your diagnosis, goals, and
long-term mobility—never a one-size-fits-all approach.

### Longevity Medicine

Longevity medicine is about keeping your body performing well as you age—so you can stay active,
independent, and resilient. Regen Axis Health supports this through targeted regenerative IV
therapies, peptide therapy, and science-driven optimization plans. It’s proactive care designed to
protect energy, recovery, and long-term movement.

## Restorative Therapies Heal From the Source

[RegenAxis Spine icon]

### RegenAxis Spine

RegenAxis Spine focuses on restoring strength and stability to the structures that support your
entire body. Using advanced regenerative therapies and precision-guided procedures, our physicians
treat common causes of back and neck pain without defaulting to surgery. The goal is simple: reduce
inflammation, support healing, and help you move confidently again.

[Learn More About RegenAxis Spine][126]

Arthritis][131] [See All][132]
[RegenAxis Joint icon]

### RegenAxis Joint

RegenAxis Joint is designed for patients who want to stay active without living around knee,
shoulder, hip, or elbow pain. Our team uses biologic therapies such as PRP and stem cell–derived
treatments to support joint health from within. Every plan is tailored to your lifestyle, mobility
goals, and long-term function.

[Learn More About RegenAxis Joint][133]

[RegenAxis Nerve icon]

### RegenAxis Nerve

RegenAxis Nerve targets pain that originates from irritated, compressed, or inflamed nerves. Whether
symptoms include radiating pain, numbness, tingling, or burning sensations, our physicians use
regenerative and precision-based approaches to calm the nerve and restore comfort. The focus is
long-term relief that protects movement—not temporary masking.

[Learn More About RegenAxis Nerve][140]

[Neuropathy][141] [Neuralgia][142] [Carpal Tunnel Syndrome][143] [Complex Regional Pain Syndrome

[RegenAxis Disc icon]

### RegenAxis Disc

RegenAxis Disc is built for patients dealing with disc-related pain, including bulging discs,
herniations, and degenerative disc disease. Our regenerative-first approach supports the disc
environment through advanced biologics and minimally invasive procedures. The goal is to reduce pain
at its origin, improve function, and help you avoid surgery whenever possible.

## Dr. Leon Reyfman

### Board-Certified Anesthesiologist & Interventional Pain Specialist

Board certified in Anesthesiology and Pain Management, Dr. Leon Reyfman serves as an Attending
Physician at Mount Sinai and Assistant Clinical Professor at SUNY Downstate. Fellowship-trained at
Columbia University, he specializes in interventional pain management and addiction medicine,
providing expert, compassionate care to patients throughout the New York City area.

[Learn More About Dr. Reyfman][153]

Regen Axis Health is supported by a team of board-certified physicians with advanced training in
spine, joint, and nerve care, working together to deliver regenerative treatment plans built around
your movement and goals.

## Relief

Regenerative Medicine Stem Cell Therapy Longevity Medicine
[Regenerative Medicine icon]

### Regenerative Medicine

Regenerative medicine uses your body’s own healing potential to support repair in injured or
degenerating tissue. At Regen Axis Health, we use science-backed treatments like PRP, shockwave
therapy, and regenerative laser to reduce inflammation, restore function, and help you return to
movement—without relying on steroids or surgery.

[Learn More About Regenerative Medicine][159]

[Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)][160] [Regenerative Joint Treatment][161] [Disc Procedures][162]
[Regenerative Spine Procedures][163] [See All][164]
[Stem Cell Therapy icon]

### Stem Cell Therapy

Stem cell–derived treatments are designed to support tissue repair at a deeper level, especially in
joints, tendons, and spine-related conditions. Regen Axis Health offers physician-led therapies
using biologics from bone marrow or adipose tissue, selected based on your diagnosis, goals, and
long-term mobility—never a one-size-fits-all approach.

[Learn More About Stem Cell Therapy][165]

[BMAC][166] [MFAT][167] [Exosomes][168] [Alpha 2 Macroglobulin][169] [See All][170]
[Longevity Medicine icon]

### Longevity Medicine

Longevity medicine is about keeping your body performing well as you age—so you can stay active,
independent, and resilient. Regen Axis Health supports this through targeted regenerative IV
therapies, peptide therapy, and science-driven optimization plans. It’s proactive care designed to
protect energy, recovery, and long-term movement.

RGn: a photomedical neurotechnology developed to treat a broad spectrum of neurological disorders.
Overview

REGEnLIFE is an advanced clinical-stage medical technology company focused on treating neurological
conditions. Nearing market launch, it is developing a pioneering, patented therapeutic solution
based on biophotonics. This non-invasive and painless application for patients takes the form of a
helmet and an abdominal belt to target the brain and/or gut, depending on the pathology. Indeed,
recent scientific studies suggest the key role of the brain-gut axis in the development of
neurological conditions.

[Learn more][134]
[View all projects[#]][135]
R&D
The RGn device developed by REGEnLIFE is currently the only photomedical technology that takes into
account emerging hypotheses on the identification of the various pathogenic factors implicated in
neurological conditions.
[View all projects[#]][136]
[[Photobiomodulation]][137]

[Photobiomodulation uses low-intensity light emission from laser or LED sources to regulate
biological functions and achieve therapeutic effects (analgesic, anti-inflammatory, healing)][138]

[Neurostimulation, as a non-pharmacological intervention, represents a rapidly expanding field of
biomedical research and therapy. It is progressively establishing itself as an alternative or
complement to pharmacological treatments for several resistant pathologies.][140]

Solutions

REGEnLIFE is able to make its devices available for clinical and preclinical research, and is
preparing to market a product dedicated to the treatment of concussions.

## Early Detection Saves Lives

At Sascan we utilize a multispectral imaging technology platform for multimodal screening and early
detection of potentially malignant lesions.

[ Discover OralScan ][54]

### Technology

Detects early biochemical and morphological tissue changes using multispectral imaging.

### Edge

Real-time monochrome imaging accurately maps hemoglobin absorption to biopsy sites

### Application

Our multimodal technology detects most cell carcinomas and adapts to endoscopy

### Impact

Our technology enables a low-cost screening of oral and cervical tissues saving lives.

## About Us

## Transforming Science Into Real World Healthcare Impact.

OralScan bridges the gap between complex biophotonics research and point-of-care patient impact by
fundamentally redefining how oral cancer is detected. OralScan is an multimodal imaging device for
the early detection of oral cancers and biopsy guidance. Backed by a proprietary ML algorithm, it
assists clinicians in identifying suspicious lesions with greater accuracy in real-time, supporting
timely diagnosis, biopsy guidance and improved patient care outcomes. By substituting invasive
anxiety with a quick, pain-free, and affordable scan, Sascan Meditech has successfully democratized
high-tech oncology diagnostics, bringing life-saving early detection out of elite hospitals and
directly into the communities where it is needed most.

## Our Impact

## Driving Innovation in Advanced Healthcare Solutions

Empowering healthcare with ML-driven innovation, advanced medical technology, and reliable screening
solutions to support clinicians, hospitals, and early disease detection for better patient outcomes.

ONE ECOSYSTEM, SIX MODALITIES

## Human Performance Isn't Built on One Technology.

Every Solbasium product is designed to work as part of a connected recovery ecosystem. By combining
complementary technologies, we help individuals and organizations build recovery environments
tailored to their goals today while creating a foundation for future innovation.

### Photobiomodulation

Red & Near-Infrared Light Therapy

Clinical-grade red and near-infrared light engineered to support cellular energy production,
recovery, and performance.

### PEMF

Pulsed Electromagnetic Field Therapy

Low-frequency electromagnetic fields designed to complement recovery and support healthy cellular
function.

### Hyperbaric Oxygen

Pressurized Oxygen Therapy

Controlled oxygen environments engineered to increase oxygen availability throughout the body.

### Cold Therapy

Contrast & Cold ExposureContrast & Cold Exposure

Purpose-built cold therapy systems designed to promote circulation, resilience, and post-exercise
recovery.

### Infrared Sauna

Thermal Recovery

Infrared heat engineered to support relaxation, circulation, detoxification, and whole-body
wellness.

### Recovery Ecosystem

Connected Performance Platform

Pads, rollers, massage devices, and future connected software engineered to deliver a seamless
recovery experience.

### **Structural** *integrity.*

## Quantum Red Light Therapy Roller

The Solbasium Quantum Roller™️ is where mechanical engineering meets photobiomodulation research. It
began with a simple question: what if recovery didn't require choosing between mobility work,
compression, and light therapy—what if one system could do all three, without compromise? The result
is a device architecture unlike anything else in recovery technology: a rolling mechanism precise
enough for myofascial release, a compression system tuned for tissue response, and a dual-wavelength
LED array engineered for depth and penetration. Every component was built to work with the others,
not around them. This is the Quantum Roller's real innovation not a single feature, but a system.
It's a glimpse of how Solbasium approaches every product: start from first principles, engineer past
the obvious trade-offs, and build something the category hasn't seen before.

## Quantum Red Light Therapy Roller

The Solbasium Quantum Roller™️ is where mechanical engineering meets photobiomodulation research. It
began with a simple question: what if recovery didn't require choosing between mobility work,
compression, and light therapy—what if one system could do all three, without compromise? The result
is a device architecture unlike anything else in recovery technology: a rolling mechanism precise
enough for myofascial release, a compression system tuned for tissue response, and a dual-wavelength
LED array engineered for depth and penetration. Every component was built to work with the others,
not around them. This is the Quantum Roller's real innovation not a single feature, but a system.
It's a glimpse of how Solbasium approaches every product: start from first principles, engineer past
the obvious trade-offs, and build something the category hasn't seen before.

  ### About
  
  ][132]
  
  Soterix Medical Inc. (SMI) was formed to develop and deploy innovative medical treatments focused
  on neuropsychiatric and neurological disorders and rehabilitation. Founded in 2008, SMI is the
  world leader in clinical trials for non-invasive neuromodulation working with over 1,200 medical
  centers in the US and worldwide. SMI has licensed and developed a comprehensive intellectual
  property portfolio that includes High-Definition transcranial Direct Current Stimulation
  (HD-tDCS), Limited Total Energy tDCS (LTE-tDCS), Neurotargeting, and improving precision of
  Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation. From the most targeted non-invasive clinical systems to the
  most portable units, Soterix Medical provides clinicians and patients with unique and adaptable
  solutions. While ongoing trials use investigational devices that are regulated/limited by US or
  Federal law, SMI has secured multiple clinical approvals worldwide (EU-CE; Canada-Health Canada;
  Brazil-Anvisa; Australia-TGA, etc.). SMI is also diversified to distribute synergistic
  technologies and provides services in image analysis, modeling,consumer product human factors, as
  well as defense and space applications. SMI currently holds multiple US clinical clearances on
  synergistic technologies. SMI is proudly based in the Tri-state area with international
  distributors in all major markets.

Are there any discounts or special offers?

The Synclite Beauty loyalty program offers a 5% discount for regular customers, as well as a 10%
birthday gift — valid during the week before and after your birthday.

Is there a warranty and service support?

Devices purchased on our website or through official partners come with a 1-year warranty and can be
serviced at a certified service center — even after the warranty period has expired.

What makes these devices different from others?

Our expertise and many years of experience allow us to select the best brands and technologies on
the market. The main advantage of these devices is their ability to act simultaneously on all layers
of the skin and soft tissues, delivering visible results. The presence of patented methods and
international certificates of conformity ensures both safety and trust.

— sculpted contours;

Frequently Asked Questions:
Which device is right for me?

We help you choose the device that best suits your skin type, needs, and skincare experience.
Providing consultations is a part of our service. To receive a specialist’s recommendation, contact
us on WhatsApp: +351 962 207 883.

Are there any discounts or special offers?

The Synclite Beauty loyalty program offers a 5% discount for regular customers, as well as a 10%
birthday gift — valid during the week before and after your birthday.

Is there a warranty and service support?

Devices purchased on our website or through official partners come with a 1-year warranty and can be
serviced at a certified service center — even after the warranty period has expired.

What makes these devices different from others?

Our expertise and many years of experience allow us to select the best brands and technologies on
the market. The main advantage of these devices is their ability to act simultaneously on all layers
of the skin and soft tissues, delivering visible results. The presence of patented methods and
international certificates of conformity ensures both safety and trust.

What results can I achieve with the device?

— sculpted contours;
— improved skin firmness;
— brighter and healthier complexion;
— reduction of wrinkles and puffiness;

2025-10-21

Three weeks have passed since the China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF), but suyzeko's
gains from the event continue.   China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF) About: CMEF is
one of China's largest and longest-running medical equipment exhibitions, held annually in multiple
locations, attracting domestic and international manufacturers, medical institutions, and
professional visitors. Main Events: New product launches of medical devices and consumables,
academic exchanges, technical training, and procurement matchmaking. Target Audience: Hospital
procurement, medical device companies, agents, distributors, industry researchers, etc.   Suyzeko
has been engaged in the production and research and development of health and physical therapy
products for 20 years, focusing primarily on red light therapy equipment and hydrogen health. We
provide comprehensive treatment options for clinics and spas, and also assist individual users with
their home care needs. The most eye-catching product at this exhibition was our new generation of
full-body red light therapy panels. We are using lens modules for the first time. The entire panel
consists of four circuit boards, each covered by four lens modules. This innovation further enhances
light concentration, achieving an optical power of approximately 250mW/cm². Furthermore, this design
provides improved maintenance for resellers. By eliminating the traditional single lens design, any
issues that arise during end-user use can be resolved by simply removing the corresponding panel.  
Each 10-15 minute treatment session leaves you feeling refreshed and energized. See a live customer
experience.

Three weeks have passed since the China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF), but suyzeko's
gains from the event continue.   China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF) About: CMEF is
one of China's largest and longest-running medical equipment exhibitions, held annually in multiple
locations, attracting domestic and international manufacturers, medical institutions, and
professional visitors. Main Events: New product launches of medical devices and consumables,
academic exchanges, technical training, and procurement matchmaking. Target Audience: Hospital
procurement, medical device companies, agents, distributors, industry researchers, etc.   Suyzeko
has been engaged in the production and research and development of health and physical therapy
products for 20 years, focusing primarily on red light therapy equipment and hydrogen health. We
provide comprehensive treatment options for clinics and spas, and also assist individual users with
their home care needs. The most eye-catching product at this exhibition was our new generation of
full-body red light therapy panels. We are using lens modules for the first time. The entire panel
consists of four circuit boards, each covered by four lens modules. This innovation further enhances
light concentration, achieving an optical power of approximately 250mW/cm². Furthermore, this design
provides improved maintenance for resellers. By eliminating the traditional single lens design, any
issues that arise during end-user use can be resolved by simply removing the corresponding panel.  
Each 10-15 minute treatment session leaves you feeling refreshed and energized. See a live customer
experience.

About Us

THE BIOHACKER Wellness Centre is a unique, full service clinic that combines the best of
conventional medicine with well-researched and effective integrative health therapies. We recognize
the importance of conventional medicine but also some of its limitations in dealing with certain
conditions.

It is often not enough to tackle patient symptomology with pharmaceutical medications alone. We
believe in using all therapeutic avenues available to us in order to address the root cause of
illness and promote healing.

[Atlantis Dubai]


It is our firm belief that when the right strategies are implemented healing is always possible. The
key to optimizing health is in understanding each patient’s biochemical individuality and the
complex interactions between genetics and the environment. Our physicians are trained in both
conventional medicine and cutting-edge integrative health therapies to help every patient find their
‘Healthiest Self’.

[NAD+ Therapy]

### NAD+ Therapy

Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD) is one of the most essential molecules in your body. In
fact, you’ll find it in every single cell working in more chemical reactions than any other
vitamin-derived molecule. When the molecule has oxidized and becomes inactive, it is known as NADH,
but in its active form, it is known as NAD+.

[Learn More ][263]
[Intravenous laser therapy]

### Intravenous laser therapy

What is IV Laser Therapy? IV Laser Therapy is an innovative treatment from Germany used to enhance
healing from both acute and chronic conditions. IV Laser Therapy is considered a major evolution of
external ultraviolet light therapy (UVBI) in terms of safety and strength.There are many uses for IV
Laser Therapy as it works through numerous healing mechanisms

[Learn More ][264]
[PeptideTherapy]

### Peptide Therapy

Peptide therapy is a cutting-edge medical treatment that involves the use of short chains of amino
acids called peptides to regulate and enhance specific functions within the body. These peptides act
as signaling molecules, helping to stimulate natural processes such as hormone production, tissue
repair, immune response, and metabolic regulation.

[Learn More ][265]
[IV Drip]

### IV Drip

IV drip therapy, also known as intravenous therapy, is a wellness treatment that delivers fluids,
vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients directly into the bloodstream through a vein. This method
allows for fast and efficient absorption, bypassing the digestive system and ensuring maximum
effectiveness.

[Learn More ][266]
[Vitamin Shots, our specialist]

### Vitamin Shots

IM or intramuscular vitamin shots, when injected into the muscle, provide a slow and long-lasting
release of the nutrients you need for almost instant results.Vitamin Shots can help enhance your
immunity, athletic performance, cognitive function, skin & hair health, and so much more. Formulated
specifically for your health goals, our vitamin blends can help take you from nutrient-deficient to
energy-abundant.

[Learn More ][267]
[Ozone Therapy]

### Ozone Therapy

We offer a superior treatment using the latest technology ozone device, that gently extracts your
blood and passes it through an oxidation chamber. Here it is combined with an equal volume of ozone
at a high concentration before being passed back into your body.

[Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy]

### Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy

Mild Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (mHbOT) is a non-invasive therapy method that has users lie in a
comfortable pressurized chamber while breathing 90% – 95% pure oxygen. The excess pressure causes
the blood plasma, all of your cells, tissues, and fluids to hold up to 10 times more oxygen than the
normal concentration.

[Learn More ][280]
[Infrared ozone sauna]

### Infrared ozone sauna

The Infrared Ozone Sauna is a tool designed with every patient in mind. From those who are looking
to maintain and increase their vitality and health, to those who are facing a chronic illness—the
Infrared Ozone Sauna offers a combination of benefits. The Infrared sauna uses infrared light to
heat you directly instead of heating the air.

About Us

THE BIOHACKER Wellness Centre is a unique, full service clinic that combines the best of
conventional medicine with well-researched and effective integrative health therapies. We recognize
the importance of conventional medicine but also some of its limitations in dealing with certain
conditions.

It is often not enough to tackle patient symptomology with pharmaceutical medications alone. We
believe in using all therapeutic avenues available to us in order to address the root cause of
illness and promote healing.

[Atlantis Dubai]


It is our firm belief that when the right strategies are implemented healing is always possible. The
key to optimizing health is in understanding each patient’s biochemical individuality and the
complex interactions between genetics and the environment. Our physicians are trained in both
conventional medicine and cutting-edge integrative health therapies to help every patient find their
‘Healthiest Self’.

[NAD+ Therapy]

### NAD+ Therapy

Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD) is one of the most essential molecules in your body. In
fact, you’ll find it in every single cell working in more chemical reactions than any other
vitamin-derived molecule. When the molecule has oxidized and becomes inactive, it is known as NADH,
but in its active form, it is known as NAD+.

[Learn More ][263]
[Intravenous laser therapy]

### Intravenous laser therapy

What is IV Laser Therapy? IV Laser Therapy is an innovative treatment from Germany used to enhance
healing from both acute and chronic conditions. IV Laser Therapy is considered a major evolution of
external ultraviolet light therapy (UVBI) in terms of safety and strength.There are many uses for IV
Laser Therapy as it works through numerous healing mechanisms

[Learn More ][264]
[PeptideTherapy]

### Peptide Therapy

Peptide therapy is a cutting-edge medical treatment that involves the use of short chains of amino
acids called peptides to regulate and enhance specific functions within the body. These peptides act
as signaling molecules, helping to stimulate natural processes such as hormone production, tissue
repair, immune response, and metabolic regulation.

[Learn More ][265]
[IV Drip]

### IV Drip

IV drip therapy, also known as intravenous therapy, is a wellness treatment that delivers fluids,
vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients directly into the bloodstream through a vein. This method
allows for fast and efficient absorption, bypassing the digestive system and ensuring maximum
effectiveness.

[Learn More ][266]
[Vitamin Shots, our specialist]

### Vitamin Shots

IM or intramuscular vitamin shots, when injected into the muscle, provide a slow and long-lasting
release of the nutrients you need for almost instant results.Vitamin Shots can help enhance your
immunity, athletic performance, cognitive function, skin & hair health, and so much more. Formulated
specifically for your health goals, our vitamin blends can help take you from nutrient-deficient to
energy-abundant.

[Learn More ][267]
[Ozone Therapy]

### Ozone Therapy

We offer a superior treatment using the latest technology ozone device, that gently extracts your
blood and passes it through an oxidation chamber. Here it is combined with an equal volume of ozone
at a high concentration before being passed back into your body.

### Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy

Mild Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (mHbOT) is a non-invasive therapy method that has users lie in a
comfortable pressurized chamber while breathing 90% – 95% pure oxygen. The excess pressure causes
the blood plasma, all of your cells, tissues, and fluids to hold up to 10 times more oxygen than the
normal concentration.

## About The Biofeedback, Education,
## & Training Center

Struggling with anxiety, poor sleep, brain fog, or feeling stuck—even when you’ve tried multiple
approaches without lasting results?


At The Biofeedback, Education & Training Center (B.E.T. Center), we take a comprehensive,
neurocognitive approach to mental health and brain wellness. Rather than focusing solely on symptom
management, we work to understand how your brain and nervous system are functioning, and how to
improve that functioning in a meaningful, lasting way.


Our services are provided by licensed clinicians and board-certified practitioners, ensuring a high
standard of care that integrates clinical expertise with advanced brain-based technologies.

 

Our process begins with a thorough, integrative evaluation that may include counseling, quantitative
EEG (QEEG) brain mapping, and both objective and subjective assessments. This allows us to identify
patterns in brain and nervous system functioning that may be contributing to symptoms such as
anxiety, ADHD, depression, insomnia, cognitive fatigue, or emotional dysregulation.

 

Based on these findings, we develop a personalized, multi-modality treatment plan that may include
neurofeedback, biofeedback, and evidence-based counseling approaches such as CBT, CBT-I, and
brainspotting. Treatment is continuously guided by clinical data, client-reported outcomes, and
observed progress, supporting a more precise and adaptive approach to care.

 

Clients who engage in this process commonly experience improvements in sleep quality, attention and
cognitive clarity, emotional regulation, and overall resilience to stress. Outcomes vary by
individual; however, our goal is to support measurable, functional improvements in daily life and
long-term brain health.

 

We proudly serve individuals and families throughout Plano, Dallas, Frisco, McKinney, Richardson,
Allen, and surrounding North Dallas Metroplex, offering both in-office and remote training options
to increase accessibility and consistency of care.

 

If you are looking for a clinically grounded, brain-based approach to improving mental wellness and
cognitive functioning, our team is here to help.


We welcome the opportunity to discuss a personalized plan aligned with your needs and goals.

## About The Biofeedback, Education,
## & Training Center

Struggling with anxiety, poor sleep, brain fog, or feeling stuck—even when you’ve tried multiple
approaches without lasting results?


At The Biofeedback, Education & Training Center (B.E.T. Center), we take a comprehensive,
neurocognitive approach to mental health and brain wellness. Rather than focusing solely on symptom
management, we work to understand how your brain and nervous system are functioning, and how to
improve that functioning in a meaningful, lasting way.


Our services are provided by licensed clinicians and board-certified practitioners, ensuring a high
standard of care that integrates clinical expertise with advanced brain-based technologies.

 

Our process begins with a thorough, integrative evaluation that may include counseling, quantitative
EEG (QEEG) brain mapping, and both objective and subjective assessments. This allows us to identify
patterns in brain and nervous system functioning that may be contributing to symptoms such as
anxiety, ADHD, depression, insomnia, cognitive fatigue, or emotional dysregulation.

 

Based on these findings, we develop a personalized, multi-modality treatment plan that may include
neurofeedback, biofeedback, and evidence-based counseling approaches such as CBT, CBT-I, and
brainspotting. Treatment is continuously guided by clinical data, client-reported outcomes, and
observed progress, supporting a more precise and adaptive approach to care.

 

Clients who engage in this process commonly experience improvements in sleep quality, attention and
cognitive clarity, emotional regulation, and overall resilience to stress. Outcomes vary by
individual; however, our goal is to support measurable, functional improvements in daily life and
long-term brain health.

 

We proudly serve individuals and families throughout Plano, Dallas, Frisco, McKinney, Richardson,
Allen, and surrounding North Dallas Metroplex, offering both in-office and remote training options
to increase accessibility and consistency of care.

 

If you are looking for a clinically grounded, brain-based approach to improving mental wellness and
cognitive functioning, our team is here to help.


We welcome the opportunity to discuss a personalized plan aligned with your needs and goals.

[SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION ][29]

ANXIETY
Anxiety is a human emotion that everyone experiences at times. When Anxiety becomes a constant
worry, we recommend consultation and assessments to determine underlying causes.
DEPRESSION
Feelings of sadness and hopelessness can keep one from reaching their full potential. Our
assessments, counseling, and training programs are highly successful at lifting symptoms of
depression.

## Services

NEUROFEEDBACK
HRV BIOFEEDBACK

I am so thankful I made that call and started with biofeedback and some counseling with Christy
dealing with some major issues in my life. I have just finished my sessions and couldn’t be more
pleased with the outcome.  I am sleeping for the first time in my life. My anxiety is gone and I
just feel so much better overall. I am prescription free and so grateful.  I highly recommend
Christy and her staff.  They are so compassionate and caring which is hard to find

## - D.W.

My son "Z" was put on Focalin because he was diagnosed with ADHD in the first grade. He acted like a

medicated anymore, and started Neurofeedback with Christy. Once having completed 33 sessions, he is
a new person. He is now significantly more organized, completes his homework and class work on time.
His grades have seen the biggest improvement course! Neurofeedback was a dream come true for our
family.

# Making sure you're not a bot!

Loading...

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

Protected by [Anubis][1] From [Techaro][2].

Mascot design by [CELPHASE][3].

This website is running Anubis version `devel`.

[2]: https://techaro.lol
[3]: https://bsky.app/profile/celphase.bsky.social

## Product Categories

Specializing in medical laser technology, our product portfolio covers a wide range of applications,
including the diagnosis of cardiovascular and peripheral vascular diseases, from intravascular
imaging to vessel visualization and beyond.

  ### [Intravascular OCT Imaging System][62]
  
  Multimodality integration provides a comprehensive solution for vascular intervention, combining
  vulnerable plaque detection, physiology assessment, and calcium assessment to guide treatment
  strategy.  
  [ [Intravascular OCT Imaging System] ][63]
* *02*
  
  ### [Patient Care][64]
  
  Vessel Visualization System uses advanced infrared imaging to project real-time vascular maps onto
  the skin, aiding medical staff in identifying optimal puncture sites. Applicable in Pediatrics,
  Oncology, Emergency Medicine, Vascular Surgery, and other specialties.  
  [ [Patient Care] ][65]

## About Vivolight

“Pioneering Advanced Healthcare Solutions”
Vivolight Medical specializes in medical laser technology, we are dedicated to the independent
development, global innovation, and in-house manufacturing of minimally invasive interventional
diagnostic and therapeutic medical devices utilizing laser technology. By integrating cutting-edge
photoelectric technology with medical and engineering expertise, we have achieved comprehensive
mastery of core underlying technologies in laser diagnostics and therapeutics, fiber-optic
catheters, and image processing. This has enabled us to develop a robust "diagnosis and treatment
integrated" platform that spans multiple disease categories.

### Alzheimer’s Clinical Results: Improved Brain Connectivity and Blood Flow (fMRI)

A UCSF fMRI study reveals Vielight Neuro Gamma's 40Hz itPBM improves ADAS-cog scores by 4.8 points,
increasing cerebral perfusion and DMN connectivity.
[ Learn more ][76]
[Alzheimer’s Clinical Results: Improved Brain Connectivity and Blood Flow (fMRI)][Alzheimer’s
Clinical Results: Improved Brain Connectivity and Blood Flow (fMRI)]

### TBI Clinical Results: Cerebellar Network Efficiency Improved by Vielight Neuro (itPBM) (n=30)

An n=30 fMRI study shows Vielight's intranasal-transcranial photobiomodulation (itPBM) improves
cerebellar network efficiency and segregation in TBI athletes.
[ Learn more ][77]
[TBI Clinical Results: Cerebellar Network Efficiency Improved by Vielight Neuro (itPBM) (n=30)][TBI
Clinical Results: Cerebellar Network Efficiency Improved by Vielight Neuro (itPBM) (n=30)]

### Parkinson's Clinical Results: Vielight Neuro Improves Cognition, Mobility and Balance

Parkinson's participants using Vielight Neuro Gamma itPBM showed sustained gains in mobility,
balance, cognition, and fine motor skills.
[ Learn more ][78]
[Parkinson’s Clinical Results: Vielight Neuro Improves Cognition, Mobility and Balance][Parkinson’s
Clinical Results: Vielight Neuro Improves Cognition, Mobility and Balance]

EEG neuromodulation with a commercial brain PBM device.

Research shows the Vielight Neuro Duo significantly reduces pediatric ASD severity and parental
stress via 6 months of home itPBM.

This TBI study (n=44) with the Vielight Neuro is the largest successful PBM trial showing

## What Does A Naturopath Do?

Naturopathic Medicine is a primary health care profession which includes a variety of naturally
based therapies. Naturopathic treatments are aimed at removing the cause of disease and support the
innate healing processes within the body. The focus of naturopathic care is centered on the
individual, their health (physical, emotional social and spiritual), family history, and lifestyle.

Our naturopathic doctors provide a data-based approach, offering lab testing and lab follow-up to
diagnose underlying problems and track the effectiveness of treatments over time.

Treatments we provide to our patients are natural, science-based and support the overall health and
strength of the patient. At the end of each visit, we prepare written treatment plans individually
for each patient’s needs. These may include nutritional supplements, herbal medicines, bio-identical
hormones and diet/lifestyle changes. There is no “one-size-fits-all” approach in naturopathic
medicine!

### What Happens At Your First Visit To A Naturopath?
1. Your naturopathic doctor will complete a detailed intake of your case which can take up to 90
   minutes. This approach allows your naturopath to learn a great deal about your health right from
   the first visit!
2. A thorough review is completed of health systems covering areas such as hormones, digestion,
   sleep, diet, stress, family history and more. As naturopathic doctors we always look for the
   underlying causes of disease and support health in a holistic way.
3. Your naturopath will help clarify your specific health goals during this session, so you can work
   on what’s most important to you.
4. After each visit, your naturopathic doctor will create an individual written treatment plan for
   you including natural treatment options, and lab testing suggestions to clarify causes or provide
   a diagnosis.

#### Follow-up visits

Follow-up naturopathic visits are booked as needed, and are typically 45, or 30 minutes in length.
In general, most patients require several consultations at the start of naturopathic care and then
move to a maintenance or followup schedule with visits scheduled less often.

Most of our patients return year-after-year to work with our NDs as their health needs change or
when new conditions arise!

Questions or want to get started?

### Naturopathic Lab Testing

[Lab testing is integral to diagnosis][95] and can create significant insight into health
conditions. Our NDs use functional medicine lab ranges that are best for optimal health, and we
often pick up causes that may have been missed in the past. Labs are a great way to take the
guesswork out of treatment and save you time on your journey back to health. Read more about our
areas of focus below.

### What Kinds of Testing Do Naturopathic Doctors Offer?

At our clinic, we offer two main branches of naturopathic lab testing:
* Testing through Ontario labs, such as Lifelabs. For these tests we will provide you with a
  requisition, and you can have your blood drawn at a lab nearby to your home or work.
* Specialized testing through International and Canadian Labs (i.e.: Organic Acids, Parasitology,
  Comprehensive Stool Analysis, Salivary Hormones, Urinary Hormone Metabolites, Food Sensitivities).

### How Much Does It Cost to See a Naturopathic Doctor in Ontario?

## What Does A Naturopath Do?

Naturopathic Medicine is a primary health care profession which includes a variety of naturally
based therapies. Naturopathic treatments are aimed at removing the cause of disease and support the
innate healing processes within the body. The focus of naturopathic care is centered on the
individual, their health (physical, emotional social and spiritual), family history, and lifestyle.

Our naturopathic doctors provide a data-based approach, offering lab testing and lab follow-up to
diagnose underlying problems and track the effectiveness of treatments over time.

Treatments we provide to our patients are natural, science-based and support the overall health and
strength of the patient. At the end of each visit, we prepare written treatment plans individually
for each patient’s needs. These may include nutritional supplements, herbal medicines, bio-identical
hormones and diet/lifestyle changes. There is no “one-size-fits-all” approach in naturopathic
medicine!

### What Happens At Your First Visit To A Naturopath?
1. Your naturopathic doctor will complete a detailed intake of your case which can take up to 90
   minutes. This approach allows your naturopath to learn a great deal about your health right from
   the first visit!
2. A thorough review is completed of health systems covering areas such as hormones, digestion,
   sleep, diet, stress, family history and more. As naturopathic doctors we always look for the
   underlying causes of disease and support health in a holistic way.
3. Your naturopath will help clarify your specific health goals during this session, so you can work
   on what’s most important to you.
4. After each visit, your naturopathic doctor will create an individual written treatment plan for
   you including natural treatment options, and lab testing suggestions to clarify causes or provide
   a diagnosis.

#### Follow-up visits

Follow-up naturopathic visits are booked as needed, and are typically 45, or 30 minutes in length.
In general, most patients require several consultations at the start of naturopathic care and then
move to a maintenance or followup schedule with visits scheduled less often.

Most of our patients return year-after-year to work with our NDs as their health needs change or
when new conditions arise!
